同一份输入，为什么要变成三个矩阵？: Why does one input become three matrices?
每个 token 的隐藏状态 X 分别乘上三个参数矩阵，得到 Query、Key: Each token's hidden state X is multiplied by three parameter matrices, giving Query, Key and Value. Q and K produce the scores; V supplies the content that is summed up at the end.
Q/K/V 是本次前向的激活。$W_Q$/$W_K$/$W_V$ 是固定参数；播: Q/K/V are activations of this forward pass. $W_Q$/$W_K$/$W_V$ are fixed parameters; playing the computation does not train or update them.
矩阵里的一个分数是怎样算出来的？: How is one score in the matrix computed?
取 Q 的一行和 K 的一行，逐维相乘再相加，最后除以 $\\sqrt{2}$。: Take one row of Q and one row of K, multiply them dimension by dimension, add up, then divide by $\sqrt{2}$. Rows of S belong to queries, columns to keys. Click a cell to check that dot product.
点积同时受方向和模长影响，不等于余弦相似度。缩放对照只是教学开关，标准公式使用: A dot product depends on both direction and length; it is not cosine similarity. The scaling switch is only for comparison – the standard formula uses $1/\sqrt{d_k}$.
M_{ij}=\\begin{cases}-\\infty & j>i\\tex: M_{ij}=\begin{cases}-\infty & j>i\text{ and causal mask on}\\0&\text{otherwise}\end{cases}
怎样让当前位置看不到未来？: How does a position stop seeing the future?
因果 Mask 将未来 Key 的分数设为 −∞，再交给 Softmax。关闭时: The causal mask sets the scores of future keys to −∞ before they reach softmax. With the mask off every position is visible; with it on, each row may only access itself and earlier positions.
Mask 必须在 Softmax 之前应用。若一行没有任何有效 Key，此实现约: The mask must be applied before softmax. If a row has no valid key at all, this implementation sets its weights and output to zero to avoid NaN.
[3, 3] → [3, 3]，沿 Key 轴逐行计算: [3, 3] → [3, 3], row by row along the key axis
为什么改一个分数，整行权重都可能变化？: Why can changing one score change the whole row of weights?
每个 Query 都有自己的归一化分母。可见 Key 的权重之和为 1；被屏蔽的: Each query has its own normalizing denominator. The weights of the visible keys sum to 1; masked positions get 0. Subtracting the row maximum leaves the result unchanged and keeps the exponential from overflowing.
这里是“取用各 Value 的比例”，不是预测下一个 token 的词表概率，也: These are “shares taken from each value” – not vocabulary probabilities for the next token, and softmax does not run down the columns.
权重不变，输出也一定不变吗？: If the weights stay the same, must the output stay the same?
对每个 Query，用这一行的 P 分别乘各个 Value，再逐维相加得到输出。: For each query, multiply every value by that row's P and add dimension by dimension to get the output. Intervening only on V leaves Q, K, S and P unchanged, yet O can change.
如果被修改的 Value 在当前行被完全屏蔽，其权重为 0，那么当前输出也不受影: If the changed value is fully masked in the current row, its weight is 0 and the current output is unaffected.

参数、程序和当前输入各自负责什么？: What do parameters, the program and the current input each do?
参数保存学到的数值，前向程序规定怎样使用它们；当前输入产生的激活会变化，推理过程: Parameters store learned numbers and the forward program defines how to use them; input-dependent activations change, while inference leaves weights fixed.

一层里有哪些模块，信息怎样流动？: Which modules form a layer, and how does information flow?

文字怎样变成编号，再变成向量？: How does text become IDs and then vectors?
Tokenizer 先产生离散 ID，Embedding 再按 ID 查表；分词: A tokenizer produces discrete IDs, then Embedding looks up vectors; token boundaries affect sequence length, while ID magnitude is not semantic distance.
顺序信息从哪里加入？: Where does order enter the computation?
同一 token 的内容嵌入可以相同，位置编码为不同位置提供不同的数值模式；加法: The same token can share a content embedding; positional encoding provides position-specific patterns, with additive encoding changing the input before projection.
调整特征尺度与构造概率有什么区别？: How do feature normalization and probability normalization differ?
LayerNorm 在一个 token 的特征轴上统计均值和方差；Softmax: LayerNorm computes statistics over one token’s features; Softmax builds probabilities over candidates, with maximum subtraction preserving the result.
线性层与非线性分别改变什么？: What do linear layers and nonlinearities each change?
矩阵投影改变特征表示，逐元素非线性让多层网络超出单次线性映射；FFN 对各 to: Matrix projections change feature representations, while elementwise nonlinearities make depth more than one linear map; FFN parameters are shared across tokens.
矩阵里的一个格子怎样算出来？: How is a single matrix entry computed?
矩阵乘法用左边的一行与右边的一列做点积；行向量约定下，参数矩阵把输入特征轴映射到: Matrix multiplication takes a left row’s dot product with a right column; under row-vector notation, weights map input features to output features.
点积、缩放和 Mask 怎样影响分数？: How do dot products, scaling and masks affect scores?

处理过的 Key 用三个状态概括：m 是已见最大分数，l 是当前尺度下的指数和，: The keys processed so far are summarized by three states: m is the largest score seen, l is the sum of exponentials at the current scale, and a is the weighted sum of values not yet divided by l. A new block first picks a common scale, then adds the old state and the block's contribution. The a/l shown is only a temporary output for the keys processed so far; only after all blocks have been read is it the row's final result.

The worked example in §21.4.4 of the Chinese original is the opposite: its maximum, 3.01, is in the first block, so the second block needs no rescaling and α = 1; compare with the “Book row (§21.4.4)” preset. 原书 21.1 从一个现象讲起：GPU 算力很强，序列一长，Attention: §21.1 of the book starts from an observation: GPUs compute fast, yet with long sequences attention slows down and may even run out of memory. The bottleneck is often not the multiplications but moving data in memory.
标准实现要先算出完整的 N × N 分数矩阵 S，写回显存（HBM），再读出来做: A standard implementation first computes the full N × N score matrix S, writes it to GPU memory (HBM), reads it back for softmax, writes again, and reads again to multiply by V. At N = 4096, one head's S alone takes about 32MB in FP16. FlashAttention moves Q, K and V block by block into fast on-chip memory (SRAM), finishes each block there, and never writes the full S and P back to HBM – with the same result as standard attention.
本页用 4 个位置手算这件事：怎样分块，怎样在只看到一部分 Key 时维护 So: This page works this out by hand on 4 positions: how to split into blocks, how to maintain softmax while seeing only part of the keys, and finally how to check against the full computation.
片上 SRAM 像书桌：放不了几本书，但取用极快；显存 HBM 像书架：能放很多: On-chip SRAM is like a desk: only a few books fit, but they are quick to reach. GPU memory (HBM) is like a bookshelf: it holds many books, but every trip means getting up. FlashAttention tries to finish one block of work on the desk and walk to the shelf less often.

The extra a yields the attention output rather than just one row of softmax.
原书 21.4.4 手算得到 50.25%，与直接计算的 50.28% 的差别来: The hand calculation in §21.4.4 of the Chinese original arrives at 50.25%; the difference from the directly computed 50.28% comes from rounding intermediate values. This page keeps full precision, and the two paths agree within 1e-12.

本页是单头前向的教学计算，T = 4、d_k = d_v = 2，忽略 batc: This page is a teaching computation of a single-head forward pass: T = 4, d_k = d_v = 2, batch ignored, dropout disabled; Q, K, V are given activations, not training parameters or real model meaning.
本例固定 Query 块为一行，沿 Key 轴顺序扫描；真实 kernel 会同: This example fixes the query block to one row and scans along the key axis in order; a real kernel processes many query rows at once and accounts for on-chip space and parallel scheduling.
递增分数与书中 21.4.4 预设固定，混合输入预设使用可复现种子；只改最后一个: The “Rising scores” and “Book row (§21.4.4)” presets are fixed; the mixed-input preset uses a reproducible seed. Changing only the first dimension of the last K does not change Q or V directly.
书中 21.4.4 预设令每行 q = [√2, 0]、K 的第一列为 [3.0: The “Book row (§21.4.4)” preset sets q = [√2, 0] for every row and the first column of K to [3.01, 0.09, 2.48, 1.95], so after scaling every row's scores are exactly the row from the book; V reuses the teaching values of “Rising scores”.
初始 m 为负无穷，l = 0，a 为零向量；首个有效块的 α 约定为 0。全屏: Initially m is negative infinity, l = 0 and a is the zero vector; by convention α is 0 for the first valid block. A fully masked block does not change the state; a whole row with no valid key returns the zero vector by convention.
分块临时空间按 B(d_k+d_v+1)+d_k+2d_v+3 个标量估算：K/: Tiled scratch space is estimated as B(d_k+d_v+1)+d_k+2d_v+3 scalars: the K/V block, the block of exponentials, one query, two vector accumulators and three scalar statistics; inputs and outputs, visualization traces and runtime overhead are not included. In a small example this number is not guaranteed to be smaller.
账本假设每元素 4 字节，实际数值计算使用 JavaScript float64: The ledger assumes 4 bytes per element while the actual arithmetic uses JavaScript float64; it is an idealized schedule count, neither the browser's allocation nor measured GPU memory or full HBM traffic.
朴素路径的 S/P 往返按 4T² 个元素计算，包含 S 写/读与 P 写/读；: The naive path's S/P round trip is counted as 4T² elements, covering S write/read and P write/read; masking is fused into the scoring stage, and separate masks, dropout, Q/K/V/O traffic and other overheads are left out.
FlashAttention 减少完整中间矩阵的保存与 HBM 往返；KV Ca: FlashAttention reduces storing full intermediate matrices and their HBM round trips; the KV cache reduces recomputing old K/V between generation steps. They solve different problems.
本页不模拟 CUDA kernel、反向重算、硬件流水线或运行时间，也不据此推算: This page does not simulate CUDA kernels, backward recomputation, hardware pipelines or run time, and it does not derive real GPU speed-ups from them.
最后位置给候选 v 的词表概率；v 遍历 a–d。这里选的是输出 token，不: Vocabulary probability of candidate v at the last position; v ranges over a–d. This selects an output token, rather than an attention weight for a historical position.
token_ids 是输入编号；t 是从 0 开始的位置。本例只用 a–d 四个: token_ids are input IDs; t is a zero-based position. This example uses symbols a–d with IDs 0–3.
E 是固定的词嵌入表 [4,4]；H_tok 为按各位置的 ID 取出的行，形状: E is the fixed [4,4] embedding table; H_tok contains rows looked up by position IDs, shape [3,4].
H₀ 是进入 Block 1 的隐藏状态；H_tok 是内容嵌入，PE 是同形状: H₀ enters Block 1; H_tok is the content embedding and PE the same-shaped sinusoidal position encoding, added featurewise.
Hₗ₋₁、Hₗ 是当前 Block 的输入、输出，均为 [3,4]；l 是从 1: Hₗ₋₁ and Hₗ are this block’s input and output, both [3,4]; l is a one-based block index and L the total count.
LayerNorm 在每个 token 的 4 个特征上独立计算；本例 γ=1、: LayerNorm works independently over each token’s 4 features; here γ=1, β=0 and ε=10⁻⁵.
当前 Block 的第一次归一化结果 [3,4]；只送入 Attention 分: First normalized result [3,4] in this block; it feeds attention while the residual path retains Hₗ₋₁.
当前 Block 的三组固定投影参数，各为 [4,4]；右上角 (l) 标记层，: This block’s three fixed [4,4] projection matrices; superscript (l) marks a layer, not a power.
h∈{0,1} 是头编号；每头 Q/K/V 为 [3,2]，dₕ=2。头内保留全: h∈{0,1} indexes heads; per-head Q/K/V have shape [3,2], dₕ=2. Heads keep all tokens and split feature columns.
每个头的 [3,3] 注意力权重，行是 Query、列是 Key；Softmax: Per-head [3,3] attention weights: Query rows, Key columns; Softmax runs over Keys.
各头先汇总自己的 Value，再沿特征列拼接，乘输出投影 W_O 得到 Atte: Heads aggregate their own Values, concatenate feature columns, then multiply by W_O to produce attention branch A, shape [3,4].
第一次残差相加后的隐藏状态 [3,4]：原 Block 输入加 Attentio: Hidden state [3,4] after the first residual addition: original block input plus attention output.
第二次 LayerNorm 的结果 [3,4]，送入 FFN；这一页的 Z 不是: Second LayerNorm result [3,4], feeding the FFN; Z on this page is not logits.
W₁ 为 [4,6]，把特征扩到 6 维；G 是逐元素 GELU 后的 [3,6: W₁ has shape [4,6] and expands to 6 features; G is the [3,6] elementwise GELU activation, using the tanh approximation.
G 为 [3,6]，W₂ 为 [6,4]，F 是压回 4 维的 FFN 分支输出: G is [3,6], W₂ [6,4]; F is the FFN branch output contracted back to [3,4].
H_L 是最后一个 Block 的输出；H_f 是最终 LayerNorm 后送: H_L is the last block’s output; H_f is the final-normalized hidden state sent to the vocabulary head.
logits 为 [3,4]，每行对 a–d 四个候选打分；输出投影复用嵌入表的: logits are [3,4], scoring a–d in each row; the output projection reuses transposed embedding table Eᵀ, illustrating weight tying.
小写 p 是词表概率；v、u 遍历四个候选，t 是位置，mₜ 是该行最大 Log: Lowercase p is vocabulary probability; v/u range over four candidates, t is position, mₜ the row’s maximum Logit. Its normalization axis differs from attention P.
T=3 是已有 token 数；只用最后一行 p[T−1]，选概率最大的候选作为: T=3 is the token count; use only the last row p[T−1] and choose the highest-probability candidate as next, breaking ties by smaller ID.
先把输入看成离散编号。本例 a、b、c、d 只是四个无语义的词表符号，已人为分词: Start with discrete IDs. Here a, b, c and d are four nonsemantic vocabulary symbols, already tokenized by hand; no real BPE runs.
为什么 ID=3 不意味着比 ID=1 更接近某种语义？: Why does ID=3 not imply a semantic distance from ID=1?
每个 ID 取出 E 的一行，不把编号作为连续数值输入线性层。相同 ID 在不同: Each ID selects a row of E rather than entering a linear layer as a continuous number. Equal IDs select equal content vectors at different positions.
重复同一个 token 时，查到的两行向量是否相同？: Do repeated tokens retrieve identical vectors?
把正弦位置编码加到内容上，再进入第一个 Block。后续 Q、K、V 都从带位置: Add sinusoidal position encoding to content before Block 1. Later Q, K and V all derive from position-aware hidden states.
为什么同一个 token 放在不同位置，H₀ 可以不同？: Why can the same token have different H₀ at different positions?
采用 Pre-Norm：先逐行归一化，再送入 Attention。残差主路保留原: Pre-Norm normalizes each row before attention. The residual stream retains the original input; statistics never mix the three tokens.
为什么残差支路不能直接用 U 替换原输入？: Why should U not replace the original residual input?
同一归一化结果乘三组参数。Q/K 用于匹配，V 提供内容；参数由种子固定生成，播: The same normalized input multiplies three parameter matrices. Q/K match positions and V provides content; seeded parameters stay fixed during playback.
Q/K/V 与 W_Q/W_K/W_V 哪些是激活，哪些是参数？: Which of Q/K/V and W_Q/W_K/W_V are activations or parameters?
按特征列切成两个头；每头沿 Key 轴归一化并汇总 V。图中两张 P 的行列都是: Split feature columns into two heads; each normalizes over Keys and aggregates V. Both P matrices index tokens, and A includes concatenation and output projection.
两张 P 的列，与最终词表概率的列有什么不同？: How do the columns of the two P matrices differ from vocabulary probabilities?
把 Attention 分支加回当前 Block 的输入。两项形状同为 [3,4: Add attention output to this block’s input. Both terms are [3,4]; this addition does not concatenate features.
这一加法的两条路径分别从哪里来？: Where do the two paths of this addition originate?
第二次 LayerNorm 读取已经混合上下文的 R，再送入 FFN。FFN 接: The second LayerNorm reads context-mixed R and feeds the FFN. The FFN then processes tokens independently with shared parameters.
FFN 会在这一步直接读取其他 token 的行吗？: Does the FFN directly read other token rows here?
从 4 个特征扩到 6 个，再逐元素应用 GELU。非线性前后两个矩阵可直接对照: Expand 4 features to 6 and apply GELU elementwise. Compare matrices before and after the nonlinearity; this example uses the common tanh approximation.
如果删掉 GELU，两次线性投影能合成一次吗？: Without GELU, can the two linear projections be combined?
第二次投影把 6 维中间激活压回 4 维，才能与残差主路逐元素相加。: The second projection contracts 6 features to 4 so the result can be added elementwise to the residual stream.
为什么 FFN 输出的最后一维必须恢复为 4？: Why must the FFN output width return to 4?
加上 FFN 分支后，这个 Block 才完成。下一层接收 H_l 作为新的隐藏: The block completes after adding the FFN branch. The next layer receives H_l, rather than looking up the original token vectors again.
Block 2 的 Q/K/V 与 Block 1 为什么通常不同？: Why do Block 2’s Q/K/V usually differ from Block 1’s?
所有 Block 结束后，再做最终 LayerNorm。这仍是每个位置的隐藏表示: After all blocks, apply the final LayerNorm. These are still per-position hidden representations, not vocabulary probabilities.
最终 LayerNorm 的输出轴是特征还是词表？: Does final LayerNorm output features or vocabulary entries?
用隐藏表示给词表里的每个候选打分。输出头绑定到输入嵌入表的转置；本例词表和隐藏维: Score every vocabulary candidate from the hidden state. The output head ties to the embedding transpose; vocabulary and hidden widths both happen to be 4 here, but are distinct axes.
logits 的一列为什么现在代表候选 token？: Why does a logits column now represent a candidate token?
对每个位置，沿 a–d 这四个词表候选归一化；这次 Softmax 的用途与 A: For each position, normalize over vocabulary candidates a–d; this Softmax has a different role from attention’s Key weights.
注意力权重和词表概率，哪个决定“取什么内容”，哪个决定“生成什么 token”？: Which distribution mixes content and which selects an output token?
贪心选择只使用最后一个位置的分布。要继续生成，需要把选出的 token 追加为新: Greedy selection uses only the last position’s distribution. Continued generation appends that token as new input; this page replays one full forward pass.
为什么前两行也有概率，生成却只使用最后一行？: Why compute earlier-row probabilities but generate from only the last row?
训练：一次前向，同时算出每个位置的预测: Training: one forward pass computes the prediction for every position at once
训练样本 a b c d e 是完整已知的。把它错开一位：输入 x = a b: The training sample a b c d e is fully known. Shift it by one: input x = a b c d, target y = b c d e. The causal mask lets row $t$ read only $x_0,\dots,x_t$, so one matrix computation yields the predictions for all 4 positions, and each position gets its own loss against its target. Knowing the target does not mean the forward pass peeks at the answer: the output of row $t$ never uses $x_{t+1}$ or anything later.
训练能并行，是因为整条序列事先已知；不会偷看，是因为因果 Mask。两件事同时成: Training can run in parallel because the whole sequence is known in advance; it does not peek because of the causal mask. Both hold at the same time.
为什么训练能一次算出所有位置？把第 2 个输入换掉，第 0、1 行的输出会不会变: Why can training compute all positions at once? If you replace input 2, do the outputs of rows 0 and 1 change?
生成：下一个输入，要等这一步的输出: Generation: the next input has to wait for this step's output
推理时只有提示 a b c。模型算出最后一个位置的分布，选出下一个 token，: At inference there is only the prompt a b c. The model computes the distribution at the last position, picks the next token, appends it to the sequence and recomputes the whole sequence. Each step uses only the output of the last row, yet the earlier rows were already computed in the previous step, with exactly the same results. That is where the repeated work hides.
生成必须一步一步来，因为下一个输入要等这一步的输出。不用缓存时，每一步都在重算前: Generation has to go step by step because the next input waits for this step's output. Without a cache, every step recomputes rows that were finished long ago.
不用缓存时，第 3 步重算的那些行里，哪些在上一步已经算过？它们的值会不会变？: Without a cache, which of the rows recomputed in step 3 were already computed in the previous step? Do their values change?

第 16.4 节 · 一个不带 KV Cache 的基线循环: §16.4 A Baseline Loop Without KV Cache
Prefill：一次处理整段提示，写好每层的 K、V: Prefill: process the whole prompt at once and write each layer's K and V
Prefill 和训练时的前向一样：提示的 3 个位置在一次因果前向里并行计算。: Prefill works like the forward pass in training: the 3 positions of the prompt are computed in parallel in one causal forward pass. The difference is that it keeps the K and V of every layer and every position as the history every later step will read. Prefill also computes an output for every position, but generation only uses the distribution at the last position to pick the first new token.
Prefill 并行处理已有上下文，写好每一层的 K、V 缓存，并给出第一个新: Prefill processes the existing context in parallel, writes the K/V cache of every layer, and yields the first new token.
Prefill 之后，缓存里一共有几组 K、V？为什么每一层都要各存一份？: After prefill, how many K/V pairs are in the cache? Why does every layer keep its own copy?
Decode：只为新 token 算 Q、K、V，再读全部历史: Decode: compute Q, K, V only for the new token, then read the whole history
每一步只喂入一个新 token。每一层只为它算一组 $q$、$k$、$v$，把: Each step feeds in only one new token. Each layer computes one $q$, $k$, $v$ for it, appends $k$ and $v$ to the cache, and uses the new $q$ to read every visible K and V in the cache. The Q of old positions need not be kept: their outputs were finished in earlier steps, and later positions only query the history with their own new Q.
缓存存的是每层每个位置的 K、V，不存 Q。新 Query 仍要读完全部可见历史: The cache stores K and V for every layer and position, not Q. A new query still has to read the whole visible history.
一次 Decode 里，每层新算了几组向量？读了几组？为什么不缓存旧的 Q？: In one decode step, how many vectors does each layer compute fresh? How many does it read? Why are old Q not cached?
第 22.2 节 · Cache 里存什么，每一步又算什么: §22.2 What Is Cached, and What Is Still Computed?
对照：结果相同，省掉的是重复工作: Comparison: same result, the repeated work is saved
同一个提示、同一组权重、同样的位置编号和 Mask，分别用“缓存 + 只算新 t: Same prompt, same weights, same position indices and mask, generated once with “cache + compute only the new token” and once with “recompute the whole sequence every step”. The logits agree at every step and the chosen tokens are the same. The difference is the work: for sequence length $n$, recomputing does $n$ K/V projections and $n(n+1)/2$ scores per layer; the cache does 1 projection and $n$ scores. What is saved is the repeated projection and scoring; reading the whole history cannot be skipped.
缓存不改变结果，只省掉重复计算。新 Query 仍要访问全部可见历史，所以不能承: The cache does not change the result; it only saves repeated computation. A new query still has to access the whole visible history, so no fixed speed-up factor can be promised.
为什么两条路线的 logits 一样？用缓存时，每一步的打分次数随什么增长？: Why are the logits of both routes the same? With the cache, what does the number of scores per step grow with?
第 22.3 节 · 计算量：先说清楚在数哪一部分: §22.3 Complexity: Name the Work Being Counted
改了前缀，哪些缓存不能再用？: If the prefix changes, which cache entries can no longer be used?
第 1 层的 K、V 只取决于本位置的 token 和位置编号。从第 2 层开始: Layer 1's K and V depend only on the token and position index at that position. From layer 2 on, each position's input already mixes in information from all earlier tokens. So changing token $j$ invalidates only position $j$ in layer 1, but every position from $j$ on in layer 2. When a sliding window drops the earliest token, all remaining position indices drop by 1, and with additive positional encoding no old entry can be reused directly.
缓存只对完全相同的前缀、位置编号、权重和运行模式有效。改动一个 token，它之: The cache is only valid for exactly the same prefix, position indices, weights and run mode. Change one token and all higher-layer cache entries after it must be recomputed.
改动第 1 个 token，第 1 层和第 2 层分别有哪些位置的缓存失效？多轮: If token 1 changes, which positions' cache entries become invalid in layer 1 and in layer 2? Why does a multi-turn chat not reuse the cache automatically?

不缓存 Q：旧位置的输出已经算完，新位置只用自己的新 Q 去查询历史。: Q is not cached: old positions' outputs are finished, and a new position queries the history only with its own new Q.

多轮对话界面本身不证明缓存被复用：需要完全相同的 token 前缀、位置编号、权: A multi-turn chat interface does not by itself prove the cache was reused: that needs exactly the same token prefix, position indices, weights and run mode.

文字先被切成一个个 token，每个 token 在词表里查到一个编号。: First the text is cut into tokens, and each token is looked up in the vocabulary to get a number.
每个编号换成一串数字，也就是一个向量。光有这些向量，模型还分不清“我爱你”和“你: Each number is swapped for a list of numbers – a vector. With these vectors alone the model still can't tell “man bites dog” from “dog bites man”, so information about who stands where is added as well.
每个词回头看看前面的词，决定从谁那里拿多少信息。比如读到“它”的时候，可以去前文: Each word looks back at the words before it and decides how much information to take from which one. When it reaches “it”, for example, it can look back for what “it” might refer to.
各自消化一下: Each one digests on its own
每个词再单独把拿到的信息加工一遍。旁边还有归一化和残差连接：前者调整特征尺度，后: Each token processes the received information separately. Normalization adjusts feature scale, while residual connections retain a direct path for the original representation.
上面两站合起来叫一个 Block。大模型会把几十个 Block 叠起来，每一层都: The two stations above together make up one block. Large models stack dozens of blocks, and each layer keeps working on the result of the previous one.
最后一层的结果变成词表里每个候选词的分数，经过 Softmax 变成概率，再按某: The output of the last layer becomes a score for every candidate word in the vocabulary; softmax turns the scores into probabilities, and a rule picks one word.
新词接到句子末尾，整个过程从头再来。为了不每次都把前文重算一遍，模型会把算过的一: The new word is appended to the end and the whole process starts over. So that it doesn't have to recompute all the earlier text every time, the model keeps part of what it has already computed in a cache.
一串数字，比如 [0.5, −1, 2]。每个 token 在每一层都用一个向量: A list of numbers, such as [0.5, −1, 2]. In every layer, each token is represented by one vector.
一张数字表格。在这些实验里，通常一行对应一个 token。: A table of numbers. In these experiments, one row usually belongs to one token.
拿左边的一行和右边的一列，对应位置相乘再全部加起来，就得到结果里的一个格子。实验: Take a row from the left and a column from the right, multiply matching positions and add everything up – that gives one cell of the result. Whenever the experiments talk about “projecting” or “scoring”, this is what they mean.
训练时学出来的数字，比如 $W_Q$。模型回答问题的时候，它们固定不动。: Numbers learned during training, such as $W_Q$. While the model is answering, they stay fixed.
处理当前这段文字时临时算出来的数字，比如 Q、K、V。换一句话，它们就跟着变。: Numbers computed on the fly for the text at hand, such as Q, K and V. Change the sentence and they change too.
一组都在 0 到 1 之间、加起来正好等于 1 的数。: A set of numbers, each between 0 and 1, that add up to exactly 1.
先读开头的问题，自己猜一猜答案。猜错了也没关系，猜过之后答案才记得住。: Read the question at the top and take a guess. Guessing wrong is fine – having guessed is what makes the answer stick.
一步一步往下点。图、数字、公式和文字说明会一起换到同一步。: Click through step by step. The figure, the numbers, the formula and the explanation always move to the same step together.
改一个数之前，先预测会发生什么，再看实际算出来的结果。: Before you change a number, predict what will happen – then look at what actually gets computed.
最后把说明藏起来，用自己的话讲一遍。讲得出来，才算真的懂了。: Finally, hide the explanations and explain it in your own words. If you can say it, you've really got it.

上下文很长、模型很大时的几种改造：只看一部分历史、压缩记忆、只叫醒一部分专家。: Changes for very long contexts and very large models: look at only part of the history, compress the memory, wake up only some of the experts.

KV 缓存有多大：先把账算清楚: How big is the KV cache? Do the accounting first
Decode 时，每一层都要保留所有历史位置的 K 和 V。缓存的元素个数等于: During decode, every layer keeps the K and V of every past position. The number of cached elements is batch size × layers × tokens × KV heads × $(d_k+d_v)$, times the bytes per element. This formula counts only the KV cache – not model weights, activations or the memory allocator's overhead. What an architecture change can affect is the number of KV heads and how many dimensions each head stores.
KV 缓存与层数、token 数、KV 头数和每头维度成正比；改架构时能动的主要: The KV cache is proportional to layers, tokens, KV heads and per-head dimension; an architecture change mainly moves the number of KV heads and the dimensions stored per head.
KV 缓存的公式里有哪几个乘数？把 KV 头从 32 减到 8，缓存变成原来的多: Which factors appear in the KV cache formula? If the KV heads go from 32 to 8, what fraction of the cache is left?

MHA、GQA、MQA：Query 头不变，K/V 头分组共享: MHA, GQA, MQA: query heads stay, K/V heads are shared by groups
MHA 里每个 Query 头都有自己的一组 K、V。GQA 把 Query 头: In MHA every query head has its own K and V. GQA splits the query heads into $G$ groups, and the heads of a group read the same K and V; $G=1$ is MQA, $G=H$ is MHA. The number of query heads and of scores stays the same; what shrinks is the K/V projection parameters and the cache. To turn MHA into GQA, the paper averages the K/V projections of the heads in a group and then trains a little longer; this page only does the averaging.
减少的是 KV 头，不是 Query 头：缓存和 K/V 投影变小，$W_Q$、: What shrinks is the number of KV heads, not query heads: the cache and K/V projections get smaller; $W_Q$, $W_O$ and the number of scores stay the same.
KV 头从 4 减到 1，哪些量变小，哪些不变？同组的两个 Query 头，注意: With KV heads going from 4 to 1, which quantities shrink and which stay? Do two query heads in the same group always have the same attention weights?

MLA：只缓存一个低维 latent，用时再还原各头的 K、V: MLA: cache only a low-dimensional latent and rebuild each head's K and V when needed
GQA、MQA 靠“几个头共用一份 K、V”省缓存；MLA 换了个思路：头数不减: GQA and MQA save cache by letting several heads share one K and V; MLA takes another route: it keeps the number of heads but compresses each token's K and V together into a very short vector $c_t$ (the latent), and only that goes into the cache. When needed, each head expands $c_t$ into its own K and V with its own matrices. So the heads' K and V are still different; they are just all computed from the same $c_t$. In this example with 4 heads of 2 dimensions each, MHA stores 16 numbers per token per layer, while MLA stores only the 3 numbers of $c_t$ plus the 2-dimensional position key from the next step – 5 in total.
MLA 缓存联合压缩后的 latent，每个头的 K、V 由它还原；头数不变。: MLA caches the jointly compressed latent and rebuilds each head's K and V from it; the number of heads stays the same.
MLA 的缓存里存的是什么？每个头的 K、V 从哪里来？它和 MQA 的“所有头: What does MLA's cache hold? Where does each head's K and V come from? How is that different from MQA's “all heads share one K and V”?

为什么 RoPE 要单独走一支？: Why does RoPE take a separate branch?
MLA 想在推理时省掉“把 $c$ 展开成 K”这一步：打分时直接拿 Query: MLA wants to skip “expand $c$ into K” at inference: when scoring, the query is matched directly against the cached $c_j$, with the expansion matrix $W_{UK}$ merged into the query side in advance (more in the next step). But RoPE rotates K by position, and the rotation angle depends on the distance between two positions; if RoPE were applied to the expanded K, the matrix between the query and $c_j$ would change with position ($R_tR_j^{\top}W_{UK}^{\top}$) and could not be merged ahead of time. DeepSeek-V2 lets the position information take a small separate branch: each head has an extra short query part with RoPE, $q^R$, and all heads share one short key part with RoPE, $k^R_t$, which also has to go into the cache.
RoPE 夹在中间会破坏矩阵吸收，所以位置信息单独走一支；共享的 RoPE Ke: RoPE in the middle would break the matrix absorption, so position information takes its own branch; the shared RoPE key also goes into the cache.
如果把 RoPE 直接加在由 latent 还原出的 K 上，同一个吸收矩阵在哪: If RoPE were applied directly to the K rebuilt from the latent, at which positions would one absorbed matrix still give the right answer? What extra does the cache hold after decoupling?

矩阵吸收：推理时不必还原 K 和 V: Matrix absorption: no need to rebuild K and V at inference
矩阵乘法可以换结合顺序：先把 $c_j$ 展开成 K 再和 Query 点积，等: Matrix products can be regrouped: expanding $c_j$ into K and then taking the dot product with the query equals first merging the expansion matrix $W_{UK}^{(i)}$ into the query projection and then taking the dot product with $c_j$ directly. The same holds on the V side, where the matrix $W_{UV}^{(i)}$ that expands V is merged into the output projection $W_O$. Inference then reads only $c_j$ and $k^R_j$ from the cache and never rebuilds each head's K and V. Both paths in the table agree; only the order of computation differs. The price is that the merged content query becomes $d_c$-dimensional.
吸收不改变结果，改变的是计算顺序：推理时只读缓存里的 latent 与 RoPE: Absorption does not change the result, only the order of computation: inference reads only the latent and the RoPE key from the cache.
吸收之后，内容 Query 的维度变成多少？为什么 RoPE 那一支不能一起吸收: After absorption, how many dimensions does the content query have? Why can the RoPE branch not be absorbed as well?
第 30.4.3 节 · MLA（书中未讲矩阵吸收，本步按论文）: §30.4.3 MLA (the book does not cover matrix absorption; this step follows the paper)
对照：每种方案省了什么，付出了什么: Comparison: what each scheme saves, and what it costs
MHA、GQA、MQA 通过减少 KV 头来缩小缓存；MLA 保留每个头各自的: MHA, GQA and MQA shrink the cache by reducing the number of KV heads; MLA keeps a separate K and V for every head and instead caches a low-dimensional latent plus a shared RoPE key. With DeepSeek-V2's configuration, MLA caches $d_c+d_h^R=512+64=576$ numbers per token per layer, about as much as a GQA with only 2.25 groups; counting only the latent misses those 64. A smaller cache does not mean better in every respect: grouping reduces the expressive freedom of K and V, and MLA needs extra up-projections or a larger query after absorption. Which fits better depends on the model, training and deployment conditions.
这些方案在缓存、参数、计算和效果之间各有取舍，不是一条从差到好的排行榜。: These schemes trade off cache, parameters, compute and quality differently; they are not a ranking from worse to better.
MLA 的缓存为什么不能只算 latent？同样的头数和头维，MHA、GQA-8: Why can MLA's cache not be counted as just the latent? With the same number and size of heads, how much do MHA, GQA-8, MQA and MLA each store per token?
为什么要在意 KV 缓存的大小？: Why care about the size of the KV cache?
KV 缓存让 Decode 不必重算历史，但它要为每一层、每个历史 token: The KV cache spares decode from recomputing the history, but it has to keep K and V for every layer and every past token (§22.4 of the book). The longer the context and the more requests served at once, the bigger the cache – it often fills GPU memory before the model weights do.
缩小它有两条路：MQA、GQA 让多个 Query 头共用一份 K、V，减少要存: There are two ways to shrink it: MQA and GQA let several query heads share one K and V, reducing the number of KV heads to store (chapter 23 of the book); DeepSeek's MLA keeps the number of heads but compresses K and V into a short vector before storing it (§30.4.3). This page starts from one cache formula and works out, step by step, how many numbers each stores.
MHA 像老师有 8 个分身，每个分身各带一本笔记本记录学生（独立的 K、V）；: Picture eight luthiers inspecting the same instrument, each asking a different question (their own Q). In MHA every luthier keeps a private pattern book (independent K and V); MQA keeps the eight questions, but everyone consults one shared pattern book; GQA sits in between – the luthiers work at several benches, and each bench shares one book.
第 23.1 节 · 为什么需要改进 MHA: §23.1 The problem is not “how many tensors”
原书 30.4.3 只讲到“先压缩、再解压”，没有讲解耦 RoPE 和矩阵吸收，: §30.4.3 of the book only covers “compress, then decompress”; it does not explain decoupled RoPE or matrix absorption, and it does not count the position key in the cache. This page adds those two steps from §2.1.2–2.1.3 of the DeepSeek-V2 paper and counts the position key in the cache size.

减少 KV 头不会减少 Query 头，也不会让整个 Attention 或整个: Fewer KV heads do not mean fewer query heads, and they do not shrink the whole attention or the whole model by the same factor: $W_Q$, $W_O$ and the number of scores stay the same.
KV 缓存公式只统计 K、V，不含模型权重、激活值和显存分配器的开销。: The KV cache formula counts only K and V – not model weights, activations or the memory allocator's overhead.
MLA 的缓存不只是 latent：解耦 RoPE 的共享 Key 也要缓存。: MLA's cache is not just the latent: the shared key of decoupled RoPE is cached too.
MLA 不是“所有头共享一组 K、V”：每个头仍有自己的 K、V，只是由同一个: MLA is not “all heads share one K and V”: each head still has its own K and V, rebuilt from the same latent.
原书第 30.4.3 节“KV Cache 减少 75%”是假设 latent: The book's “KV cache shrinks by 75%” in §30.4.3 is an illustrative calculation assuming a latent of 1/4 the original size, not a measurement by DeepSeek.
GQA 从 MHA 转换时，论文在组内取平均之后还要继续训练（约 5% 的原预训: When converting MHA to GQA, the paper keeps training after averaging within groups (about 5% of the original pre-training compute); this page only averages and does not represent the quality after conversion.
MHA、GQA、MQA、MLA 不是一条排行榜：缓存、参数、计算与效果之间各有取: MHA, GQA, MQA and MLA are not a ranking: they trade off cache, parameters, compute and quality differently.
Router 怎样决定每个 token 去哪里？: How does the router decide where each token goes?
每个 token 的隐藏状态是一行 $x_t$。路由器（Router）用同一组参: Each token's hidden state is a row $x_t$. The router scores the four experts with one shared set of parameters $W_R$, then applies softmax along the expert axis to get a row of probabilities. Changing a token's input changes its routing scores; here every token is routed independently and reads no other token. The experts are only numbered E0–E3 and have no pre-assigned meaning.
路由器的输入是隐藏状态，输出是对各专家的分数；分数来自计算。: The router's input is the hidden state and its output is a score per expert; the scores come from computation.
这一行有几个分数？Softmax 沿哪个轴？只改 t1 的输入，t0 的路由会变: How many scores does this row have? Along which axis does softmax run? If only t1's input changes, does t0's routing change?

选择 K 个专家后，权重还要怎样处理？: After choosing K experts, what happens to the weights?
本实验取概率最高的 K 个专家，再把选中概率除以它们的和，得到门控权重（Gate: This experiment takes the K experts with the highest probabilities and divides their probabilities by their sum to get the gate weights. Unselected weights are 0 and the selected ones sum to 1, so with K = 1 the only gate value is 1. Ties go to the expert with the smaller number. This is an explicit teaching variant: softmax → top-k → renormalize; Switch's top-1 keeps the original probability, so the gate values of this example do not carry over to it.
先选集合，再按本例规则重新归一化；Top-K 的选择和门值是两件事。: First choose the set, then renormalize by this example's rule; choosing the top k and the gate values are two separate things.
只保留两个专家，原概率的和一定是 1 吗？为什么本例 Top-1 的门值恒为 1: If only two experts are kept, do their original probabilities have to sum to 1? Why is the top-1 gate value always 1 in this example?
Transformers · MixtralTopKRouter 的选中后归一化: Transformers · renormalization after selection in MixtralTopKRouter
专家收到的是原输入，算出的是向量: Experts receive the original input and compute a vector
选中的专家各自收到同一行输入，用独立参数执行两层前馈网络（FFN）：先从 2 维: Each selected expert receives the same input row and runs a two-layer feed-forward network (FFN) with its own parameters: from 2 dimensions up to 3, through ReLU, back to 2. The routing probability is not an input to the expert. In this example the output of E0 can be scaled on its own: that changes the result of this branch, while expert choice and gate values stay the same for fixed input and router.
Router 负责选路，专家负责变换输入；门值在之后的合并中使用。: The router chooses the route, the experts transform the input; the gate values are used in the combine that follows.
每个专家的两块权重是什么形状？只把 E0 的输出乘以 2，路由概率为什么不变？: What shapes do each expert's two weight matrices have? If only E0's output is doubled, why do the routing probabilities stay the same?
Shazeer et al. §2、§3.2 · 独立的前馈专家: Shazeer et al. §2, §3.2 · independent feed-forward experts
把专家输出按原 token 身份合回来: Combine the expert outputs back by token identity
每个被选中的专家返回一个 2 维向量；逐维乘对应的门值，再相加，得到这个 tok: Each selected expert returns a 2-dimensional vector; multiply it dimension by dimension by its gate value and add them up to get this token's output. After dispatch the data is grouped by expert, so on the way back it must be put into its original place by token index before the combine. This page checks the grouped execution side by side with a direct per-token computation; the two paths must agree within floating-point tolerance.
合并的是同一个 token 的多条专家分支，token 的身份和原始顺序都要保留: What is combined is several expert branches of the same token; token identity and original order must both be kept.
t1 被两个专家处理，会产生两个输出 token 吗？返回顺序改变后怎样恢复正确: t1 is processed by two experts – does that produce two output tokens? If the return order changes, how is the correct result restored?
只激活 K 个专家，为什么还要存全部参数？: Only K experts are active – so why store all parameters?
切换分散与集中输入，观察每个专家实际接到多少条任务。每个 token 都选 K: Switch between spread-out and concentrated input and watch how many tasks each expert actually receives. Every token picks K experts, so the total number of tasks is still T × K, but the distribution can be very uneven. In this example each expert has 12 parameters and the router 8, 56 in total; each token uses 8 + 12K. Unselected experts must keep their weights for later inputs.
总参数决定要保存多少权重；激活参数和任务数描述本次计算，负载描述任务分布。: Total parameters decide how much weight must be stored; active parameters and task counts describe this computation; load describes how the tasks are distributed.
K 从 1 变成 2，哪些参数账单不变？任务集中在一个专家，会自动变得更快吗？: When K goes from 1 to 2, which parameter totals stay the same? If the tasks pile up on one expert, does it automatically get faster?
权重留在设备上，输入过去、结果回来: Weights stay on their device; inputs travel there and results come back
双设备时，t0、t2 起始在设备 0，t1、t3 在设备 1；E0、E1 位于设: With two devices, t0 and t2 start on device 0 and t1 and t3 on device 1; E0 and E1 live on device 0, E2 and E3 on device 1. Only remote expert branches need to send the input and return the result, D numbers in each direction. Switch to a single device and the output stays the same while cross-device communication drops to 0. The figure shows the logical data flow, with no central relay node; a real implementation can exchange the data in bulk with All-to-All.
专家并行搬运激活而非广播全部权重；通信量取决于路由、放置和数据大小。: Expert parallelism moves activations instead of broadcasting all weights; the communication volume depends on routing, placement and data size.
同一个 token 选到本地和远端两个专家，各需要传什么？为什么箭头数量不能表示: If one token picks one local and one remote expert, what does each need to send? Why can the number of arrows not represent the actual time?
为什么要准备很多个专家，却每次只用其中几个？: Why prepare many experts but use only a few of them each time?
原书 30.1.1 的例子：Mixtral 8x7B 总参数约 46.7B，但每: The example in §30.1.1 of the book: Mixtral 8x7B has about 46.7B parameters in total, but each token activates only about 12.9B. MoE replaces one large FFN with several “expert” FFNs, and a router picks a few of them to compute for each token.
这样总参数可以很大，每个 token 的计算量却只随被选中的专家增长。代价是：全: That way the total parameter count can be large while each token's compute grows only with the experts it selects. The price: all experts' weights must still be stored, tasks can pile up on a few experts, and across devices activations have to travel back and forth. This page works out these accounts by hand with 4 tokens and 4 experts.
全科医生要用全部知识看每个病人；专家会诊先经过分诊台（Router），按症状把病: Not every reviewer reads every pull request: the team lead (the router) reads the description and assigns the two most suitable reviewers (top-2). The team covers more expertise than any single generalist, yet the cost per PR is bounded by how many reviewers take part. The roles are only a metaphor: the experts on this page are numbered E0–E3 and have no pre-assigned meaning.
原书 30.1.3 用“心内科、骨科”等科室比喻专家；真实专家的分工来自训练，不: §30.1.3 of the book likens experts to reviewers with specialties such as security or performance; real experts get their division of labour from training, not by assignment. This page only numbers them E0–E3.
原书 30.2.5 讨论 Top-1、Top-2 的取舍，没有给出门值的归一化规: §30.2.5 of the book discusses the trade-off between top-1 and top-2 but gives no normalization rule for the gate values; this page explicitly uses “softmax → top-k → renormalize within the selected set”, matching the Mixtral router in Transformers.
原书第 30 章 · Mixture of Experts（选题与章节映射）: Chapter 30 · Mixture of Experts (topic choice and chapter mapping)
Hugging Face Transformers · Mixtral 路由实现: Hugging Face Transformers · Mixtral router implementation
E0–E3 没有手工指定的“数学”“代码”等职责；本例权重是可复现的教学数字，不: E0–E3 have no hand-assigned roles such as “math” or “code”; the weights in this example are reproducible teaching numbers, not data from a real model.
本例只演示一个 MoE 层：没有共享专家、容量上限、丢弃、重路由或辅助损失，也没: This example shows a single MoE layer only: no shared expert, capacity limit, dropping, re-routing or auxiliary loss, and no training.
本例 Top-1 重新归一化后门值为 1；其他架构可能保留原概率，门控规则必须随: In this example the top-1 gate value is 1 after renormalization; other architectures may keep the original probability, so the gating rule must be stated with the model.
稀疏激活不意味着只需存储本次选中的参数；权重卸载是另一种实现选择，本例未实现。: Sparse activation does not mean only the parameters selected this time need to be stored; offloading weights is a separate implementation choice, not implemented here.
负载柱表示任务数量。MAC 计数只统计矩阵乘加，不包括 ReLU、Softmax: Load bars show task counts. MAC counts include only matrix multiply-adds, not ReLU, softmax, routing or the weighted combine, and they are not run times.
通信账本固定每个元素 4 字节，只统计远端输入和返回向量；不含 token 编号: The communication ledger assumes 4 bytes per element and counts only remote input and return vectors; it excludes token indices, gate values, protocol, padding and backward communication in training. The arithmetic still uses JavaScript float64.
本例逐分支统计通信，不合并发给同一设备的重复输入；实际实现的批处理和去重可能改变: This example counts communication per branch and does not merge duplicate inputs sent to the same device; batching and deduplication in a real implementation can change the byte count.
i 是 Query 行，j 是 Key 列；k 在分母中遍历同一行的所有 Key: i is the Query row, j the Key column; k runs over all Keys in the denominator. Positions start at 0.
第 i 行加上 Mask 后的最大分数；减去它可避免指数溢出。: Maximum masked score in row i; subtract it to avoid exponential overflow.
Oᵢ 是第 i 行输出；Pᵢⱼ 是它分给位置 j 的权重；Vⱼ 是该位置的 Va: Oᵢ is output row i; Pᵢⱼ is its weight for position j; Vⱼ is that position’s Value row vector.
Query 矩阵第 i 个 token、第 a 个特征的数值；下标中的数字是从: Value at token i, feature a of the Query matrix; numeric subscripts are zero-based row and column indices.
第 i 个 Query 与第 j 个 Key 的分数；展开式中每对数按同一个特征: Score of Query i against Key j; each pair of numbers multiplies the same feature dimension.
第 i 个 Query 的第 a 个输出特征；展开式依次累加“Key j 的权重: Output feature a for Query i; sum “weight for Key j × feature a of Value j” over j.
Δ 表示改动前后的差值；这里只改变 V[1,0]，观察第 i 行输出的第 0 维: Δ means the change from before to after; only V[1,0] is changed, observing feature 0 of output row i.
第 i 个 Query 分给 token 1 的权重；固定 Q、K 和 Mask: Weight Query i assigns to token 1; with Q, K and Mask fixed, it is independent of ΔV.
zᵢ 是词表候选 i 的 Logit，pᵢ 是其概率；i、j 遍历词表候选。: zᵢ is vocabulary candidate i’s Logit, pᵢ its probability; i and j index vocabulary candidates.
温度（Temperature），必须大于 0；越小通常越集中，越大通常越平坦。: Temperature, strictly greater than 0; lower usually concentrates the distribution, higher flattens it.
A 是保留的 K 个候选集合；指示函数对保留项取 1，其余取 0；p′ 是过滤后: A is the retained set of K candidates; the indicator is 1 for retained items, 0 otherwise; p′ is the renormalized distribution.
P 是 Top-P 阈值；p_(i) 按概率从大到小排列；m 是累计概率首次达到: P is the Top-P threshold; p_(i) is sorted descending; m is the fewest candidates reaching P, k a count variable.
u 是 [0,1) 内均匀随机数；沿过滤后的概率 p′ 累加，首次超过 u 的候: u is uniform on [0,1); accumulate filtered probabilities p′ and select index i at the first crossing of u.
y₁、y₂ 是先后两个输出 token；条件概率表示已选 y₁ 后生成 y₂ 的: y₁ and y₂ are consecutive output tokens; the conditional probability predicts y₂ after y₁, and log is the natural logarithm.
W₁ 是从 2 维扩到 3 维的参数；H 是投影后的中间激活，形状 [4, 3]: W₁ projects 2 features to 3; H is the intermediate activation, shape [4, 3].
H 是非线性之前的激活，U 是逐元素 ReLU 后的结果；形状相同。: H is the pre-activation, U the elementwise ReLU result; their shapes match.
U 是 3 维中间激活，W₂ 投回 2 维；F 是 FFN 分支输出，形状 [4: U is the 3-feature activation, W₂ projects back to 2; F is the FFN branch output, shape [4, 2].
Y 是残差相加后的输出；X 走直连路径，F(X) 是 FFN 分支的计算结果。: Y is the residual sum; X takes the direct path and F(X) is the FFN branch result.
J 是输出对输入的导数矩阵（Jacobian）；I 是直连路径贡献的单位矩阵。: J denotes a Jacobian, the matrix of output derivatives with respect to input; I is the direct path’s identity contribution.
D(F) 是 Dropout 后的分支；p 是丢弃率，mᵢ 以 1−p 的概率取: D(F) is the dropped-out branch; p is the drop probability, mᵢ is 1 with probability 1−p and 0 otherwise; i indexes elements.
两层之间没有非线性时，可以先把两个参数矩阵相乘，合成一个线性投影。: Without a nonlinearity between layers, multiply both parameter matrices into one linear projection.
t 是当前 Query 位置，b 是当前 Key/V 块编号，B 是块最多包含的: t is the Query position, b the Key/V block index, B its maximum rows; j ranges over Keys in that block.
依次是当前 Query 行、Key 块、Value 块、该块分数和对应 Mask: Query row, Key block, Value block, block scores and its Mask; K/V blocks use the same token rows.
m 是处理旧块后的最大分数；m′ 是合入新块后的最大分数。撇号表示更新后。: m is the maximum score after old blocks; m′ includes the new block. A prime means the updated value.
l 是当前尺度下的指数和（标量）；a 是未归一化的 Value 加权和（d_v: l is the exponential sum at the current scale (scalar); a is the unnormalized Value sum (d_v-vector); primes mean updated.
重缩放系数：把旧分母 l 和旧分子 a 一起换到新最大值的指数尺度。: Rescaling factor: move both old denominator l and numerator a to the new maximum’s exponential scale.
s 是本块第 j 个分数，r 是减去新最大值后的指数，v 是对应的 Value: s is block score j, r its exponential after subtracting the new maximum, v its Value row vector.
当前已处理 Key 的暂时输出；只有读完所有可见块，才是这一行的最终结果。: Partial output for processed Keys; it becomes the final row only after all visible blocks are processed.
t 索引 Query 行，d 索引输出特征，冒号表示整行；online 与 fu: t indexes Query rows, d output features, colon means the whole row; online and full are tiled and full-matrix results.
第 t 行读完所有 Key 后的加权和与指数和；同一行的向量 aₜ 除以标量 l: Weighted sum and exponential sum after all Keys for row t; divide vector aₜ by scalar lₜ.
逐行、逐特征检查最大绝对误差；本例 float64 核对容差为 10⁻¹²。: Check the maximum absolute error over rows and features; this float64 example uses tolerance 10⁻¹².
前者是完整 S/P 的中间元素数，后者是它们写回、读回的元素次数；0 只针对这两: Full S/P intermediate element count, then their write/read transfer count; 0 applies only to these two matrices.
完整 Attention 的算术增长量级：每对 Query–Key 仍需打分并参: Arithmetic growth of full attention: every Query–Key pair still contributes to scoring and Value aggregation.
W_Q、W_K、W_V 是当前层从隐藏向量生成 Query、Key、Value: W_Q, W_K and W_V are this layer’s parameters projecting hidden vectors into Query, Key and Value; fixed during inference.
训练损失：每个位置的目标 token 负对数概率，再对 T 个位置取平均。: Training loss: average target-token negative log probability over T positions.
xₜ 是位置 t 的输入 token，yₜ 是下一位置的目标 token；T 是: xₜ is the input token at position t, yₜ the next-position target; T is the input length, t starts at 0.
p 是给定可见前缀后预测目标的概率；−log p 在预测目标概率越低时越大。: p is the target probability given the visible prefix; −log p grows when that probability decreases.
n 是已有 token 数，v 遍历词表；选择概率最大的 v，作为新 token: n is the existing token count, v ranges over the vocabulary; choose the most probable v as new token xₙ.
最后一个已有位置的隐藏向量，用来预测接下来的 token。: Hidden vector at the last existing position, used to predict the next token.
ℓ 是层编号，L 是总层数；右上角 (ℓ) 表示这一层，不是乘方。: ℓ is the layer index, L the total layer count; superscript (ℓ) denotes a layer, not a power.
当前层的输入隐藏状态；来自上一层，形状为 [已有 token 数, 隐藏维数]。: Input hidden states of the current layer, from the previous layer; shape [existing tokens, hidden width].
K、V 是当前层要缓存的激活；W 是该层固定的投影参数。: K and V are this layer’s cached activations; W denotes its fixed projection parameters.
下标 n 指新位置：h 是本层输入，q/k/v 是新投影，o 是新 Query: n denotes the new position: h is the layer input, q/k/v the new projections, o the new Query’s attention output.
把新位置的 k、v 追加为缓存的新行；同一层的历史行保持原顺序。: Append the new k and v as cache rows, keeping historical rows of the same layer in order.
本例每层 Query / Key 的维数；√d 是分数缩放因子。: Query / Key width per layer in this example; √d is the score scaling factor.
L 是层数，n 是包含当前位置的序列长度；这里只数 Query–Key 打分配对: L is the layer count, n the sequence length including the current position; only Query–Key score pairs are counted.
位置 t 的第 1 层输出，以及第 2 层据此投影的 K、V；它们依赖从 x₀: Layer-1 output at position t and its layer-2 K/V projections; they depend on the prefix x₀ through xₜ.
本例第 1 层的因果前向计算；第 t 行只能使用截至 t 的输入。: This example’s causal layer-1 forward computation; row t only uses inputs up to t.
bytes 是 KV 缓存总字节数；b 是每个缓存元素占用的字节数。: bytes is total KV cache size in bytes; b is bytes per cached element.
依次是批大小、层数、token 数、KV 头数；缓存公式将这些数量相乘。: Batch size, layers, tokens and KV heads, respectively; multiply these counts in the cache formula.
每个 KV 头的 Key、Value 维数；相加因为两种向量都要保存。: Key and Value widths per KV head; add them because both vectors are cached.
h 是从 0 开始的 Query 头编号，H 是 Query 头数，G 是 KV: h is a zero-based Query head index, H the Query head count, G the KV group count; g(h) gives the head’s group.
头 h 使用自己的 Q，以及所属组共享的 K、V；headₕ 是该头的输出。: Head h uses its own Q and its group’s shared K/V; headₕ is that head’s output.
⌊x⌋ 向下取整得到组号；d 是每头 Query / Key 维数。: ⌊x⌋ rounds down to obtain a group index; d is the Query / Key width per head.
hₜ 是位置 t 的隐藏行向量；乘下投影参数 W_DKV 得到联合 KV 压缩向: hₜ is the hidden row vector at position t; down-projection W_DKV produces joint KV latent cₜ.
第 i 个头的 Key、Value 上投影参数，把同一个 latent 展开为各: Key and Value up-projections for head i, expanding the same latent into each head’s own content vectors.
位置 t、第 i 个头的内容 Key、Value；右上角 C 表示内容分支。: Content Key and Value at position t, head i; superscript C denotes the content branch.
C 表示内容分支，R 表示带 RoPE 的位置分支；[·;·] 在此沿特征维拼接: C denotes content, R the RoPE position branch; [·;·] here concatenates feature dimensions.
t 是当前 Query 位置，j 是历史 Key 位置，i 是头编号；共享的位置: t is the current Query position, j a historical Key position, i a head index; shared position Keys have no head index.
隐藏向量 hⱼ 乘共享投影 W_KR，再按位置 j 做 RoPE；结果 kᴿⱼ: Project hidden vector hⱼ with shared W_KR, then apply RoPE at j; cache the resulting kᴿⱼ as well.
hₜ 是当前位置的输入隐藏行向量；W_QC 是该头的内容 Query 投影，W_: hₜ is the input hidden row vector at the current position; W_QC is this head’s content Query projection, W_O its output projection block. Associativity allows precombining them.
pⱼ 是当前头分给 Key j 的权重；cⱼ 是缓存中的 latent，先加权汇: pⱼ is this head’s weight for Key j; cⱼ is its cached latent, aggregated before up-projection.
H 是 Query 头数，G 是 KV 组数，dₕ 是每头内容维数，d_c 是: H is Query heads, G KV groups, dₕ content width per head, d_c latent width, dₕᴿ shared position-Key width.
W₀ 是冻结的基础权重，形状 [D, K]；Y₀ 是只走基础分支的输出。: W₀ is the frozen base weight, shape [D, K]; Y₀ is the base-branch output.
D 是输入维数，K 是输出维数，r 是适配器的中间秩（rank）；这里 K 不表: D is input width, K output width, r the adapter rank; K here does not denote Keys.
A、B 是可训练的低秩矩阵；ΔW 是它们相乘并缩放后形成的权重增量。: A and B are trainable low-rank matrices; ΔW is their scaled product, the weight update.
α 是适配器缩放超参数；除以秩 r 得到增量分支的倍率。: α is the adapter scaling hyperparameter; divide by rank r to scale the update branch.
基础分支输出加适配器分支输出；两条路径的输出形状相同。: Base output plus adapter output; both branches have the same output shape.
W₀,q 是低比特存储的基础权重；dequant 将其恢复为本次乘法使用的数值。: W₀,q is the low-bit stored base weight; dequant reconstructs values used for this multiplication.
适配器参数个数；A 有 D×r 个、B 有 r×K 个，只统计这两组。: Adapter parameter count: D×r in A and r×K in B; only these two matrices are counted.
t 是当前 Query 位置，j 是可见 Key 位置，w 是窗口宽度；保留当前: t is the Query position, j a visible Key position, w the window width; keep the current and up to w−1 past positions.
wₜⱼ 是未归一化的核权重，qₜ/kⱼ 是 Query/Key 行向量；φ 是逐: wₜⱼ is an unnormalized kernel weight, qₜ/kⱼ Query/Key row vectors; φ is the elementwise feature map ELU(x)+1.
Sₜ 累积 Key 特征与 Value 的外积，zₜ 累积 Key 特征；状态覆: Sₜ accumulates Key-feature/Value outer products, zₜ Key features, through position t; S here is not a score matrix.
位置 t 的 Query、Key、Value 和输出行向量；φ(qₜ) 查询累积: Query, Key, Value and output row vectors at t; φ(qₜ) queries accumulated state, then the denominator normalizes it.
A 是混合输出，A_mem 是历史记忆输出，A_local 是局部 Attent: A is the mixed output, A_mem the memory output, A_local local attention; σ(β) is a gate between 0 and 1.
M 是压缩记忆矩阵；old/new 表示更新前后，V̂_old 是旧记忆预测的: M is compressed memory; old/new mean before/after update, V̂_old is its predicted Value; residual V−V̂_old corrects it.
φ(K) 是对 Key 矩阵逐元素做特征映射，V 是对应的 Value 矩阵。: φ(K) applies the feature map elementwise to Keys; V is the corresponding Value matrix.
Z 是 Router 的打分矩阵；W_R 是路由参数，形状为 [输入维数, 专家: Z is the Router score matrix; W_R is the routing parameter matrix, shape [input width, expert count].
T 是 token 数，D 是输入维数，E 是专家数；t 索引 token，e、: T is tokens, D input width, E experts; t indexes tokens, e and j index experts.
依次是 token t 对专家 e 的分数、Softmax 概率，以及该 tok: Score and Softmax probability of expert e for token t, and that token’s maximum expert score.
Aₜ 是 token t 选中的专家集合；K 是每个 token 选择的专家个数: Aₜ is the selected expert set for token t; K is the number of experts selected per token.
p 是全体专家的路由概率；g 是只在选中专家内重新归一化后的门值，未选中的为 0: p is the routing probability over all experts; g is renormalized over selected experts, 0 otherwise.
xₜ 是一个 token 的输入行；fₑ 是专家 e 的两层 FFN，W₁、W₂: xₜ is one token’s input row; fₑ is expert e’s two-layer FFN, with its own W₁ and W₂ parameters.
yₜ 是 token t 的合并输出，所有行组成 Y；在选中集合 Aₜ 内，按门: yₜ is token t’s combined output; rows form Y. Weight expert outputs by g over selected set Aₜ.
D 是输入/输出维数，E 是专家总数，F 是专家中间维数，K 是每 token: D is input/output width, E total experts, F expert hidden width, K selected experts per token, T tokens.
依次是总参数量、每 token 激活参数量、专家 e 收到的任务数；DE 统计: Total parameters, active parameters per token, and tasks assigned to expert e; DE counts Router parameters.
依次是发往远端专家、返回结果，以及两者合计的字节数。: Bytes dispatched to remote experts, returned bytes, and their sum.
R 是跨设备的 token–专家分支数，D 是每个向量的维数，b 是每元素字节数: R is cross-device token–expert branches, D vector width, b bytes per element; here b = 4.
注意力头数；每个头保留全部 token，只分取投影后的特征列。: Number of attention heads; every head keeps all tokens and takes a slice of projected feature columns.
本例每个头的 Q、K、V 维数，等于隐藏维数除以头数。: Q, K and V width per head in this example: hidden width divided by head count.
下标 h 指第 h 个头；三者形状均为 [token 数, 每头维数]。: h denotes head h; all three have shape [token count, width per head].
第 h 个头的 Attention 输出；每个头独立归一化并汇总自己的 Valu: Attention output of head h; each head normalizes independently and combines its own Values.
A 是各头输出沿特征列拼接后的矩阵；token 的行顺序保持不变。: A concatenates head outputs along feature columns, keeping token rows in their original order.
W_O 是输出投影参数；右上角 (h) 表示与第 h 个头相乘的行块。: W_O is the output projection; superscript (h) selects its row block multiplied by head h.
拼接结果 A 再乘 W_O 后的最终输出；形状为 [T, d_model]。: Final output after multiplying concatenated A by W_O; shape [T, d_model].
这里 transpose 只交换“token”和“头”两个轴；每个 token: Here transpose swaps only the token and head axes; each token keeps its corresponding features and values.
x 是一个 token 的特征向量，D 是特征数；i、j 都只遍历同一行的特征。: x is one token’s feature vector, D its width; i and j range only over features in that row.
μ 是该行均值，σ² 是该行方差；方差在本例中除以 D。: μ is the row mean, σ² its variance; the variance here divides by D.
zᵢ 是 LayerNorm 的归一化特征；rᵢ 是 RMSNorm 的归一化特: zᵢ is a LayerNorm-normalized feature, rᵢ an RMSNorm-normalized feature; RMSNorm does not subtract the mean.
防止分母为 0 的小正数；它也会让归一化后的方差略有变化。: Small positive constant preventing a zero denominator; it also slightly affects the normalized variance.
γᵢ 是第 i 维的缩放参数，βᵢ 是平移参数；y 是最终输出，LN/RMS 标: γᵢ scales feature i, βᵢ shifts it; y is the final output, with LN/RMS indicating the normalization.
s 是温度 τ 缩放并加 Mask 后的分数，p 是概率，m 是最大有效分数；M: s is the score after temperature τ and Mask, p its probability, m the largest valid score; Mᵢ is 0 or −∞.
x 是整行输入，c 是加到每个特征的同一个常数；LN 表示 LayerNorm。: x is the input row, c the same constant added to each feature; LN means LayerNorm.
E 是词嵌入表；按位置 t 上的 token 编号取出一行内容向量。: E is the embedding table; look up the content vector for the token at position t.
x 是未加位置的内容行向量；i 是当前 Query 位置，j 遍历各 Key，O: x is a content row vector without position; i is the Query position, j runs over Keys, Oᵢ is the aggregate.
当前向量的维数；在 Attention 分数中用 √d 缩放。: Current vector width; √d scales the attention scores.
位置编码（Positional Encoding）；每个位置一行，与隐藏状态有相: Positional Encoding: one row per position, with the same feature width as the hidden state.
pos 是从 0 开始的位置；i 是维度对编号，2i 与 2i+1 是该对的正弦: pos is a zero-based position; i indexes dimension pairs, 2i and 2i+1 are their sine and cosine columns.
e 是内容嵌入，p 是位置向量；下标 m、n 分别指两个 token 的位置。: e denotes a content embedding, p a position vector; m and n are the two token positions.
两个 token 的位置编号；n − m 是它们的相对位移。: Position indices of two tokens; n − m is their relative displacement.
q、k 是固定内容向量；带撇号的是按位置旋转后的 Query、Key。本式用列向: q and k are fixed content vectors; primes denote position-rotated Query and Key. This rotation formula uses column vectors.
R 是二维旋转矩阵，逐维度对作用；下标是位置，α 是旋转角，单位为弧度。: R is a 2D rotation matrix applied to each dimension pair; subscripts are positions, α is the angle in radians.
θᵢ 是第 i 个维度对每前进一个位置转过的角度；i 从 0 开始，d 是 Q/: θᵢ is the angle advanced per position by dimension pair i; i starts at 0, d is the total Q/K width.
按相对位移 n − m 旋转；共同平移不变性要求内容 q、k 与频率规则固定。: Rotation by relative displacement n − m; joint-shift invariance requires fixed q, k and frequency rules.
此处是 ALiBi 的头斜率（slope），控制距离惩罚强度；不是 RoPE 的: Here m is the ALiBi head slope controlling distance penalties, distinct from the RoPE position index.
距离偏置；i 为 Query 位置、j 为可见 Key 位置，取负距离 −(i: Distance bias: i is the Query position, j a visible Key position; value −(i − j).
R 的下标 m、n 是 RoPE 的位置；后面 mB 中的 m 是 ALiBi: Subscripts m and n on R are RoPE positions; in the later mB, m is the ALiBi slope and B the distance bias. These are three alternatives shown for comparison.
w 表示偏好的回答（winner），l 表示另一个回答（loser）；r 是各自: w denotes the preferred answer (winner), l the other (loser); r denotes their reward scores.
Sigmoid 函数，把奖励差等实数映射到 0 与 1 之间。: Sigmoid function, mapping real values such as reward differences to a value between 0 and 1.
模型认为回答 w 优于回答 l 的概率；≻ 表示“更受偏好”。: Probability that answer w is preferred to answer l; ≻ means “preferred to”.
π_θ 是当前策略对回答的概率，π_ref 是固定参考策略；θ 表示当前策略参数: π_θ gives current-policy answer probabilities, π_ref is the fixed reference policy; θ denotes current policy parameters.
L 是要最小化的 DPO 损失；β 控制相对参考策略的对数概率差的缩放。: L is the DPO loss to minimize; β scales the log-probability difference relative to the reference policy.
J 是要增大的裁剪目标；ρ 是新/旧策略概率比，A 是优势；clip 将比例限制: J is the clipped objective to maximize; ρ is the new/old policy ratio, A the advantage; clip bounds the ratio to [1−ε,1+ε], with clipping width ε.
G 是同一 prompt 的回答数，rᵢ 是各回答奖励，r̄ 是组均值；Aᵢ 是: G is answers to the same prompt, rᵢ their rewards, r̄ the group mean; Aᵢ is the reward deviation divided by group standard deviation; i/j index answers.
J 是组平均目标；ρᵢ 是新/旧概率比，Aᵢ 是组内优势，β 缩放相对参考策略的: J is the group-averaged objective; ρᵢ is the new/old ratio, Aᵢ the group advantage, β scales reference-policy KL penalty kᵢ. clip uses the current ε bounds.
kᵢ 是当前回答的 KL 样本惩罚；分子是参考概率，分母是当前策略概率，两者都需: kᵢ is the answer’s sampled KL penalty; numerator is reference probability, denominator current-policy probability; both must be positive.
b 是量化位数；q_max 是对称整数范围的正端点，本例使用 [−q_max,: b is quantization bits; q_max is the positive endpoint of the symmetric integer range [−q_max, q_max].
g 是分组编号，x_g 是该组原值，s_g 是该组量化步长；cap 限制用于计算: g is the group index, x_g its original values, s_g its quantization step; cap bounds the magnitude used to compute it.
i 索引原始元素；xᵢ 是原值，qᵢ 是整数编码，带帽的 x̂ᵢ 是反量化近似值: i indexes original elements: xᵢ is the original, qᵢ its integer code, x̂ᵢ the dequantized approximation.

所有分组步长的存储字节数；本例每组保存一个 4 字节的步长。: Bytes for all group scales; this example stores one 4-byte scale per group.
均方误差（Mean Squared Error）：逐元素反量化误差的平方，再取平: Mean Squared Error: average squared dequantization error over elements.
B 是整数载荷与步长元数据的总字节数；b 是每个整数编码的位数。: B is total bytes of integer payload and scale metadata; b is bits per integer code.
输入隐藏状态矩阵；每行一个 token，每列一个特征。: Input hidden-state matrix: one token per row, one feature per column.
查询（Query）矩阵：各位置用什么去匹配 Key。: Query matrix: what each position uses to match Keys.
键（Key）矩阵：各位置提供给 Query 匹配的特征。: Key matrix: the features each position offers for matching Queries.
值（Value）矩阵：按注意力权重汇总的内容。: Value matrix: the content combined using attention weights.
把 X 投影为 Q、K、V 的参数矩阵；本次前向中保持固定。: Parameter matrices projecting X into Q, K and V; fixed during this forward pass.
注意力分数矩阵；行是 Query 位置，列是 Key 位置。: Attention score matrix: rows are Query positions, columns are Key positions.
注意力权重矩阵；每行给出取用各个 Value 的比例。: Attention weight matrix: each row gives the proportions used to combine Values.
Attention 输出矩阵；每行是一个 Query 汇总得到的新向量。: Attention output matrix: each row is the new vector aggregated for one Query.
加到分数上的掩码（Mask）；可见处为 0，屏蔽处为 −∞。: Mask added to scores: 0 for visible entries, −∞ for masked entries.
每个 Query / Key 向量的维数；除以其平方根来缩放分数。: Number of dimensions per Query / Key vector; its square root scales the scores.
每个 Value 和输出向量的维数。: Number of dimensions per Value and output vector.
当前序列的 token 数；若矩阵每行对应一个 token，T 就是行数。: Number of tokens in the current sequence; if each matrix row is a token, T is the row count.
每个 token 的隐藏状态维数，也就是输入的特征列数。: Hidden-state width per token: the number of input feature columns.
右上角 ⊤ 或 T 表示转置：交换矩阵的行列，向量也随之切换行、列写法。: Superscript ⊤ or T means transpose: swap matrix rows and columns, or switch row and column vector notation.
求和：把下标遍历到的各项相加。: Sum: add the terms over the indicated index.
指数函数；Softmax 把分数转成非负的相对权重。: Exponential function; Softmax converts scores into nonnegative relative weights.
沿指定轴把分数归一化；有效候选的权重和为 1。: Normalize scores along the specified axis; weights of valid candidates sum to 1.
实数矩阵的形状：a 行、b 列；方括号 [a, b] 也表示同一形状。: Shape of a real-valued matrix: a rows, b columns; [a, b] denotes the same shape.
逐元素取 max(0, x)：负数变 0，非负数保留。: Apply max(0, x) elementwise: negative values become 0, nonnegative values remain.
round 四舍五入到整数；clip 把数值限制到给定上下界。: round rounds to an integer; clip limits a value to the given bounds.
t 是时间/位置；xₜ 是当前输入，hₜ₋₁ 是旧状态，hₜ 是新状态，yₜ 是: t is time/position; xₜ is input, hₜ₋₁ old state, hₜ new state, yₜ output. All are scalars here.
Ā 控制旧状态保留多少，B̄ 控制新输入写入多少，C 将状态读成输出；横线表示离: Ā controls state retention, B̄ input writing, C reads the state into an output; bars denote discretized coefficients.
Δ 是基础步长；Δₜ、Bₜ、Cₜ 是本例按当前 xₜ 生成的步长、写入和读出系数: Δ is the base step size; Δₜ, Bₜ and Cₜ are this example’s input-dependent step, write and read coefficients.
平滑的正值函数，保证本例输入相关的步长为正；0.5、0.25、0.1 是教学设定: Smooth positive function ensuring a positive input-dependent step; 0.5, 0.25 and 0.1 are teaching choices.

a、c 是连续两步的输入，δ 是对第一步的改动，λ = exp(ΔA) 是固定保: a and c are two consecutive inputs, δ changes the first, λ = exp(ΔA) is fixed retention; compensating the second by −λδ gives the same final state h₂.
解码：从分数到下一个 token: Decoding: from scores to the next token

Turn the temperature, top-k and top-p knobs and watch the probabilities get flattened, cut off and shared out again; replay a random draw with a fixed seed; and finally see whether greedy search and beam search reach different results within two steps.

概率有了，到底选哪个词？总挑最大的，还是按概率抽？: We have the probabilities – so which word do we take? Always the biggest, or a random draw?

The second step has many options: always take the largest, draw by probability, draw only among the top few… That is the decoding strategy.

概率分布是解码策略的输入；策略决定怎样从中选。: The probability distribution is the input to a decoding strategy; the strategy decides how to choose from it.

温度控制分布的集中程度，不是质量开关。: Temperature controls how concentrated the distribution is; it is not a quality switch.

先选集合，再重新归一化，是两个步骤。: Choosing the set and renormalizing are two separate steps.

跨过阈值的 token 必须保留，然后重新归一化。: The token that crosses the threshold must be kept, and then the distribution is renormalized.
抽一次：随机数落在哪一段，就选谁: Draw once: whichever segment the random number lands in is picked

The same distribution, strategy and seed replay exactly; a single draw says nothing about long-run frequencies.

可复现需要同时记下分布、策略和随机种子。: Reproducibility needs the distribution, the strategy and the random seed recorded together.

Greedy takes the largest at every step: {#0}; Beam-2 keeps the two best prefixes at every step: {#1}; the best of all 9 paths, by exhaustive search, is {#2}. {#3} Finally, predict: if top-p is tightened, does the filtered distribution change?
这组数里贪心恰好也是最优；调高温度或换预设再看。: With these numbers greedy happens to be optimal too; raise the temperature or switch presets and look again.

FFN 与残差：一行向量怎样被变换？: FFN and residuals: how is a row vector transformed?
这里有四个 token，每个只有两个数。你会看到 FFN 先把它们拉宽到更多维、: There are four tokens here with just two numbers each. You'll watch the FFN widen them to more dimensions, pass them through ReLU and squeeze them back to two, and then add the original input back on – that's the residual connection. Finally, switch between training and inference to see when dropout actually does anything.
这一页想弄明白：Attention 读完上下文之后，每个位置还要怎样加工: The question here: after attention has read the context, how is each position processed further?
每个位置单独加工一遍，再把原来的输入加回去。: Each position is processed on its own, then the original input is added back.
为什么每个 Block 里还要有 FFN、残差和 Dropout？: Why does every block also have an FFN, residuals and dropout?
Attention 让各位置互相读取信息，本质上是一次加权汇总。FFN（前馈网络: Attention lets positions read from one another; at heart it is a weighted summary. The FFN (feed-forward network) then processes each position on its own: expand, apply a nonlinearity, and project back to the original dimension. As chapter 7 of the book puts it, a neural network extracts features from the input and makes decisions based on them.
网络一深，信息和梯度都要穿过很多层。残差连接让输入“跳过”这一层，直接加到输出上: In a deep network, information and gradients have to pass through many layers. A residual connection lets the input skip this layer and be added straight to the output; dropout switches off some activations at random during training so the model does not lean too heavily on a few features.
高速公路与轮流休假（13.2、13.3.3）: A bypass lane and a rehearsal with missing parts (§13.2, §13.3.3)
残差像一条绕开收费站的直道：这一层还没学好，原信息也能原样通过。Dropout: The residual connection is a bypass lane: even if this layer has not learned much yet, the original information can pass through unchanged. Dropout is like a small consort rehearsing while one part is occasionally silent: if the same instrument always carries every cue, the arrangement becomes brittle; when a part drops out, the others have to learn enough of the piece to hold it together.
每个位置单独升维：2 维变成 3 维: Each position is expanded on its own: 2 dimensions become 3
X 的每一行是一个 token（本例 4 个，每个 2 维）。同一个 $W_1$: Each row of X is one token (here 4 of them, 2 dimensions each). The same $W_1$ multiplies every row, turning 2 dimensions into a 3-dimensional intermediate feature H. For t0: {#0} times $W_1$ gives {#1}. Rows do not read from one another – that is the division of labour between FFN and attention. A real model's intermediate dimension is far larger than 3; this example uses the smallest size you can compute by hand and leaves out biases.
修改 t1 的输入，会不会直接改变 t0 的 FFN 输出？: If t1's input changes, does t0's FFN output change directly?
FFN 对每个位置单独加工，参数在各位置共享；跨位置交流由 Attention: The FFN processes each position separately with parameters shared across positions; communication between positions is attention's job.
