ReLU：负数清零，正数照常通过: ReLU: negatives become zero, positives pass through
对 H 的每个数做 ReLU：负数变成 0，正数保持不变。有了这一步，FFN 才: Apply ReLU to every number of H: negatives become 0, positives stay as they are. This step is what lets the FFN represent kinks instead of only straight lines. With ReLU off, the two matrix multiplications collapse into one (the last step checks this), so the extra layer adds nothing. Coordinates d0–d2 have no pre-assigned meaning.
为什么两次矩阵乘法之间要加入非线性？: Why put a nonlinearity between the two matrix multiplications?
没有非线性，多次线性变换仍然等于一次线性变换。: Without a nonlinearity, several linear maps are still just one linear map.
降回原来的维度，才能和输入相加: Back to the original dimension so it can be added to the input
再乘 $W_2$，把 3 维中间特征投影回 2 维。左图的圆点是原输入 X，方块: Multiplying by $W_2$ projects the 3-dimensional intermediate features back to 2 dimensions. In the figure on the left, circles are the original input X and squares the FFN output F(X), with a line joining each token's pair. The shape is back to [4, 2], so the next step can add it to the input entry by entry. The 2-D figure only shows teaching values, not a real semantic space.
残差相加前，两条支路必须满足什么形状条件？: Before the residual addition, what shape condition must the two branches meet?
FFN 的中间维度可以更大，但输出必须回到残差流的维度。: The FFN's intermediate dimension can be larger, but its output must return to the dimension of the residual stream.
残差：把原输入直接加回来: Residual: add the original input straight back
输出 = 原输入 + FFN 结果。以 t0 为例：{#0} + {#1} =: Output = original input + FFN result. For t0: {#0} + {#1} = {#2}; the squares in the figure on the left are the summed positions. When differentiating, this direct lane contributes an identity matrix I (the Jacobian of t0 in the table = I + $J_F$), so the gradient has at least one path that does not go through the FFN. Other branches can still cancel it, so a residual does not guarantee that the gradient never vanishes.
为什么有一条恒等路径，仍不能保证总梯度永远非零？: Why does an identity path still not guarantee that the total gradient is never zero?
残差保留一条直达的信息与梯度通路，不是把 FFN 再算一遍。: The residual keeps a direct path for information and gradients; it does not compute the FFN again.
训练时随机关掉一部分，推理时全部保留: During training some are switched off at random; at inference all are kept
当前是训练模式，丢弃率 p = {#0}：被抽中的 FFN 输出置 0，留下的除: Training mode, dropout rate p = {#0}: the FFN outputs that are drawn are set to 0, and the rest are divided by 1 − p = {#1} so the average size stays the same. What gets dropped are activations, not parameters; only the FFN branch is dropped, the residual lane is untouched. The mask comes from a fixed seed; real training draws a new one on every forward pass.
当前是推理模式：Dropout 不起作用，FFN 输出原样加回。训练时留下的值已: Inference mode: dropout does nothing, and the FFN output is added back unchanged. The values kept during training were already divided by 1 − p, so inference needs no extra factor (inverted dropout). What gets dropped is always activations, never parameters.
为什么推理时不用再乘 1 − p？被屏蔽的是参数还是激活？: Why does inference not multiply by 1 − p? Is it parameters or activations that are masked?
本例用 inverted Dropout：训练时补偿，推理时直接通过。: This example uses inverted dropout: compensate in training, pass straight through at inference.
对照：线性能合并，非线性不能；训练与推理不同: Comparison: linear maps merge, nonlinear ones don't; training differs from inference
表中并列 $X(W_1W_2)$ 与当前 F(X)：关掉 ReLU 时两者相等。: The table puts $X(W_1W_2)$ next to the current F(X): with ReLU off the two are equal. Then predict: if you switch to inference mode, does the residual output change? It usually does when dropout stops acting; if p = 0, or the FFN branch happens to be 0, it may not.
非线性、Dropout 和残差各自解决哪个问题？: Which problem does each of nonlinearity, dropout and the residual solve?
比较输出前先写明运行模式；训练时的随机前向与推理输出不是同一个条件。: State the run mode before comparing outputs; a random forward pass in training and the inference output are not the same condition.
第 13.5 节 · 残差连接 + Dropout 的协同作用: §13.5 How Residual Connections and Dropout Work Together
切换到推理，当前残差输出会保持不变吗？: If you switch to inference, does the current residual output stay the same?
只演示位置独立的两层 ReLU FFN，省略偏置、归一化和完整 Transfor: Only a position-wise two-layer ReLU FFN is shown; biases, normalization and the full Transformer are left out.
Jacobian 以行输入坐标、列输出坐标展示；ReLU 在零点的导数约定为 0: The Jacobian is shown with input coordinates as rows and output coordinates as columns; the derivative of ReLU at zero is taken as 0.
没有执行反向传播或优化；Dropout 掩码只作用于 FFN 分支。: No backpropagation or optimization is run; the dropout mask only acts on the FFN branch.
原书 7.7.1 节的图里出现“春 = 30%、江 = 70%”的概率，书中注明: A figure in §7.7.1 of the Chinese original shows probabilities such as 30% and 70% for two characters; the book notes that they come from the final LM head, not the FFN. The FFN on this page outputs only vectors and produces no probabilities.
原书 13.4 节比较 Pre-Norm 与 Post-Norm；本页只演示 F: §13.4 of the book compares Pre-Norm and Post-Norm; this page only shows the FFN sublayer itself and leaves out where LayerNorm sits.
LoRA：冻结底座，更新从哪里进入？: LoRA: with the base frozen, where does the update come in?
两个 token、每个两维，就足够看清 LoRA 的全过程：原权重冻结不动，旁边: Two tokens with two numbers each are enough to see all of LoRA: the original weights stay frozen, a low-rank side branch is added, and the two outputs are summed. Play with the rank and the update strength α, then compare two options: merging everything into a single weight, or running on a quantized base.
这一页想弄明白：不改原权重，模型的输出怎样被调整: The question here: how is a model's output adjusted without changing its original weights?
原权重一个数都不改，旁边接一条小小的低秩支路，两边的输出相加。: Not a single original weight changes; a small low-rank branch sits alongside, and the two outputs are added.
为什么不直接改全部参数，而要加一条低秩旁路？: Why add a low-rank bypass instead of just changing all parameters?
全参数微调 7B 模型，光是参数、梯度和 Adam 状态就要约 56GB 显存；: Full fine-tuning of a 7B model needs about 56GB of GPU memory for the parameters, gradients and Adam state alone, and every task needs its own full 14GB copy of the model (§26.1.1 of the book).
研究者发现，微调时权重的变化量 ΔW 往往可以用两个小矩阵相乘来近似。LoRA: Researchers found that the weight change ΔW during fine-tuning can often be approximated by the product of two small matrices. LoRA therefore freezes the original weights W₀ and trains only those two small matrices. The example in §26.2.1 of the book: a 1024 × 512 matrix has 524,288 parameters; with r = 32 the two small matrices have 32,768 + 16,384 = 49,152, about 9.4% of the original.
第 26.1、26.2.1 节 · 为什么需要高效微调: §26.1 Why Efficient Fine-Tuning Exists · §26.2.1 The math
原来的权重 W₀ 不动，但照样参与计算: The original weights W₀ do not change, but they still take part in the computation
输入 X 有两行，即两个 token，各 2 维。底座输出 $XW_0$：t0: The input X has two rows, i.e. two tokens of 2 dimensions each. Base output $XW_0$: t0 = {#0}, t1 = {#1}. “Frozen” only means $W_0$ is not updated during training; the forward pass still multiplies by it and it still has to be stored.
为什么冻结后还需要保存并读取 W₀？: Why must W₀ still be stored and read after it is frozen?
冻结等于不更新，不等于不计算、不存储。: Frozen means not updated – not “not computed” or “not stored”.
新增一条窄旁路：先压到 r 维，再还原: Add a narrow bypass: squeeze to r dimensions, then expand again
输入先乘 A，从 2 维压到 r = {#0} 维（表中的 XA），再乘 B 回: The input is first multiplied by A, squeezed from 2 dimensions to r = {#0} (XA in the table), then multiplied by B back to the output dimension; the whole bypass is then scaled by α/r = {#1}. The book writes B @ A in column-vector form, where A also acts first; this page uses row vectors and writes XAB, the same order. A and B here are non-zero teaching numbers, as if training had already run for a while.
低秩约束限制的是 W₀ 还是 ΔW？: Does the low-rank constraint limit W₀ or ΔW?
rank 限制的是更新 ΔW，不是对 W₀ 的无损压缩。: Rank limits the update ΔW; it is not a lossless compression of W₀.
两条支路的输出逐项相加: The outputs of the two branches are added entry by entry
t0：底座 {#0} + 更新 {#1} = {#2}。α = 0 时更新支路为: t0: base {#0} + update {#1} = {#2}. With α = 0 the update branch is 0, and the output is the original model. §26.2.3 of the book initializes B to all zeros for the same reason: at the start of training the model is exactly the original.
只改 α，底座输出 XW₀ 会变吗？: If only α changes, does the base output XW₀ change?
更新只从旁路进入输出；底座的数值没有被改动。: The update enters the output only through the bypass; the base values are not touched.
训练完，可以把更新并回权重: After training, the update can be merged back into the weights
因为 $XW_0 + X\\Delta W = X(W_0 + \\Delta: Since $XW_0 + X\Delta W = X(W_0 + \Delta W)$, ΔW can be added straight into $W_0$ after training, and inference no longer needs the bypass; the figure on the left gives the same result as the previous step. The adapter has r(D + K) parameters, currently {#0}, against {#1} in the base. Here D = K = 2 is too small, so r = 2 already saves nothing; only the book's 1024 × 512, r = 32 example gets down to about 9.4%.
合并为什么成立？更大的 rank 一定效果更好吗？: Why does merging work? Is a larger rank always better?
合并是代数恒等式，可以验证；任务效果要靠训练和评估。: Merging is an algebraic identity you can verify; task quality depends on training and evaluation.
QLoRA：底座用 4 bit 存，适配器保持高精度: QLoRA: the base is stored in 4 bits, the adapter stays high-precision
QLoRA 把冻结的底座压成 4 bit 存储，计算前再还原到计算精度；A、B: QLoRA squeezes the frozen base into 4-bit storage and restores it to compute precision before use; A and B are still trained in high precision. The base output in the figure on the left comes from the quantized-then-restored $W_0$, so it differs slightly from the previous step. Real QLoRA uses the NF4 format; this page substitutes uniform 4-bit and only illustrates how the three precisions divide the work.
存储位宽、计算精度和适配器训练精度为什么不能混为一谈？: Why must storage bit width, compute precision and adapter training precision not be confused?
QLoRA 的量化底座仍然冻结，只有适配器参与训练。: QLoRA's quantized base is still frozen; only the adapter is trained.
账本：底座、适配器与计算分开算: Ledger: base, adapter and compute are counted separately
表中分别列出底座、量化底座与适配器的字节数。先预测：只改变 α，LoRA 输出会: The table lists the bytes of the base, the quantized base and the adapter separately. Predict first: if only α changes, does the LoRA output change? α scales the update bypass, so the output usually changes; only when the bypass happens to be 0 does it stay the same.
α = 0 时是什么模型？B 全零初始化怎样保证训练开始时输出不变？: What model is it when α = 0? How does initializing B to all zeros keep the output unchanged at the start of training?
底座与更新分开核算；训练的参数少，不等于整个模型不用存储。: Base and update are accounted for separately; training few parameters does not mean the whole model needs no storage.
只改变 α，当前 LoRA 输出会保持不变吗？: If only α changes, does the current LoRA output stay the same?
没有反向、优化器或真实微调数据；二维教学矩阵只演示一个线性层，A、B 是固定的非: No backward pass, optimizer or real fine-tuning data; the 2-D teaching matrices show a single linear layer, and A and B are fixed non-zero teaching numbers.
量化分支以对称均匀 4bit 代替 NF4，没有 Double Quantiza: The quantized branch substitutes symmetric uniform 4-bit for NF4 and has no double quantization or paged optimizers, so it only shows a simplified QLoRA data flow.
JS float64 计算与账本中的假想 float32 存储明确分开；账本不是: JS float64 arithmetic is kept clearly separate from the hypothetical float32 storage in the ledger; the ledger is not a GPU dtype or memory measurement.
原书 26.4.1 按列向量写 $W_{orig} + (\\alpha/r)B: The book writes $W_{orig} + (\alpha/r)BA$ with column vectors (A is r × D, B is N × r); this page writes $XW_0 + (\alpha/r)XAB$ with row vectors (A is D × r, B is r × K). Both first reduce to r dimensions with A and then restore with B.
原书 26.2.1 说参数“只有原来的 9%”，精确值是 49,152 ÷ 52: §26.2.1 of the Chinese original says the parameters are “only 9% of the original”; the exact value is 49,152 ÷ 524,288 = 9.375% (the English edition says about 9.4%).
原书 26.4.2 中 B 全零初始化，训练开始时 ΔW = 0。本页的 A、B: The book initializes B to all zeros, so ΔW = 0 at the start of training (§26.2.3). This page's A and B are non-zero teaching numbers showing an update that has already been learned; the “Zero update” preset uses α = 0 to get the same starting output.
历史访问：稀疏连接与压缩状态: Access to history: sparse links and compressed state
同一份 Q、K、V，先用完整 Attention 算一遍，再只看一个滑动窗口算一: Take the same Q, K and V: compute full attention once, then again looking only at a sliding window, and compare. Next, check step by step how linear attention keeps a running state and how Infini-attention keeps a segmented memory – and see what “fewer connections” and “compressed history” each cost.
这一页想弄明白：历史太长时，怎样少看一些，或把它压缩起来: The question here: when the history gets too long, how do you look at less of it, or compress it?
历史太长时，要么只看一部分，要么压缩成一个小状态：两种省法，代价不同。: When the history gets too long, either look at only part of it or squeeze it into a small state: two ways to save, at different prices.
上下文越来越长，每个 token 都要看全部历史吗？: As context grows, does every token have to look at the whole history?
完整 Attention 里，每个位置都要和所有可见历史打分，配对数随长度按平方: In full attention, every position scores all visible history, so the number of pairs grows with the square of the length; during generation the KV cache also grows linearly with length (§24.1 of the book).
三类思路：稀疏 Attention 只连最近或重要的位置；Linear Atte: Three ideas: sparse attention links only to recent or important positions; linear attention changes the scoring so the history is compressed into a fixed-size state; Infini-attention compresses old segments into a memory and combines it with local attention over the current segment. Each saves something different, at a different price.
读小说不必回看每一页（24.2.1）: Reading a novel without rereading every page (Chinese original, §24.2.1)
读到第 500 页时，你不会同时回看前 499 页的每个字，只会记得最近读过的内: On page 500 you do not reread every word of the previous 499 pages; you remember what you read recently, key sentences at the start of chapters, and the important characters. Sparse attention lets each token attend to only some of the positions in the same way.
第 24.1、24.2.1 节 · 为什么 n² 是瓶颈: §24.1 Full Attention has three separate bills
基线：每个位置读取全部可见历史: Baseline: every position reads all visible history
先固定一份 Q、K、V：Q 是输入的四个二维行，K 把这两维交换，V 就是输入本: First fix one set of Q, K, V: Q is the four 2-D rows of the input, K swaps their two dimensions, and V is the input itself (a teaching construction). Under the causal mask, row t can read t + 1 positions. Each line in the figure on the left is one read; the thicker it is, the larger the weight. The following steps are all compared with this baseline.
一行可以读取几个历史位置？: How many past positions can one row read?
先固定基线，才能分清改变的是算法还是执行方式。: Fix the baseline first, so you can tell whether the algorithm or only the execution changed.
滑动窗口：只看最近 w 个位置: Sliding window: look only at the latest w positions
窗口 w = {#0}（含自身）：每个位置只保留最近的 Key，Softmax: Window w = {#0} (including itself): each position keeps only the most recent keys, and softmax distributes weight among those positions only, so both the denominator and the output change. An estimate in §24.8.2 of the Chinese original: with N = 8, d = 4 and w = 3, the multiplications drop from about 512 to about 192. This page checks the math with a dense matrix plus a mask, which does not mean computation is actually saved; that depends on the implementation.
缩小窗口，分母和输出为什么都会变？: Why do both the denominator and the output change when the window shrinks?
稀疏连接限制可见集合；能否真正省计算取决于实现。: Sparse links restrict the visible set; whether computation is really saved depends on the implementation.
第 24.4 节 · Sliding Window Attention: §24.3 Sliding Window: simple idea, easy off-by-one
Linear Attention：换一种打分方式: Linear attention: a different way to score
把 Softmax 里的 exp(q·k) 换成两个正值特征的点积 φ(q)·φ: Replace the exp(q·k) inside softmax with the dot product of two positive features φ(q)·φ(k), where φ(x) = ELU(x) + 1. The associativity of matrix multiplication then lets K and V be combined first (§24.4 of the book). This step first computes it explicitly by definition, as the baseline for the recurrence in the next step. It is a different attention, and its output generally differs from the softmax version.
为什么这一行不能要求等于标准 Softmax 的输出？: Why can this row not be expected to equal the standard softmax output?
Linear Attention 换了打分核，不是 Softmax 的无损改写。: Linear attention changes the scoring kernel; it is not a lossless rewrite of softmax.
第 24.5.2 节 · 矩阵乘法的结合律: §24.4 Linear Attention is not Softmax with different parentheses
把历史累加进固定大小的状态: Accumulate the history into a fixed-size state
逐个读入 token：把 $\\phi(k_t)^\\top v_t$ 加进矩阵: Read tokens one at a time: add $\phi(k_t)^\top v_t$ to the matrix S and $\phi(k_t)$ to the vector z; to read out, multiply each by $\phi(q_t)$ and divide. No matter how many tokens have been read, S and z hold only {#0} numbers in total. The recurrence in the table matches the explicit computation of the previous step entry by entry.
状态大小依赖序列长度 T 吗？为什么训练能组织成扫描？: Does the state size depend on the sequence length T? Why can training be organized as a scan?
固定特征维度时，历史被压进固定大小的状态，扫描工作随 T 线性增长。: With a fixed feature dimension, history is compressed into a fixed-size state and the scan grows linearly with T.
第 24.5.4 节 · Linear Attention 的实现: §24.4 Linear Attention is not Softmax with different parentheses
Infini-attention：旧片段进记忆，当前片段局部算: Infini-attention: old segments go into memory, the current segment is computed locally
每 2 个 token 一段。处理一段时，先从上一段留下的记忆里读出一份结果，再: One segment per 2 tokens. When a segment is processed, a result is first read from the memory left by the previous segment, then gated together with causal attention inside this segment: memory gets σ(β) = {#0}. Only after reading is this segment written into memory, and the whole segment reads the same old memory. Current update rule {#1}: linear writes V directly; delta writes only the part the memory does not yet predict.
把记忆更新放在当前段读取之前，会泄漏什么信息？: What would leak if the memory were updated before the current segment reads it?
局部 Attention 与压缩记忆分工合作，不能画成一个无限长的完整缓存。: Local attention and compressed memory divide the work; they cannot be drawn as one infinitely long full cache.
第 24.6.2 节 · Infini Attention 的核心思想: §24.5 Infini-attention: cross-segment state is what stays fixed
压缩会丢信息：两段不同的历史，可能得到同一个状态: Compression loses information: two different histories can end up in the same state
表中两段历史的 V 不同，压缩后的 S 和 z 却完全相同，之后读出时就无法区分: The two histories in the table have different V, yet the compressed S and z are exactly the same, so later reads cannot tell them apart. The book also warns that Infini-attention cannot remember all history losslessly. Finally, predict: if only the window is enlarged, does the current sparse output change?
两段不同的历史压到同一个状态后，还能恢复各自的值吗？: Once two different histories are compressed into the same state, can their individual values be recovered?
固定大小的状态会丢信息；能算更长的序列，不等于能可靠记住。: A fixed-size state loses information; being able to compute longer sequences does not mean remembering them reliably.
只扩大窗口，当前稀疏输出会保持不变吗？: If only the window is enlarged, does the current sparse output stay the same?
窗口只是稀疏连接示例，没有实现完整 Longformer 或块稀疏 GPU ke: The window is only an example of sparse links; a full Longformer or a block-sparse GPU kernel is not implemented.
Infini 的片段长度固定2；初始空记忆分母为0时返回零。分段更新不逐 tok: Infini's segment length is fixed at 2; when the initial empty memory has denominator 0 it returns zero. The segmented update does not read new memory token by token.
本页保留过程数据以便核对，不是节省内存的运行时；不测量 GPU 吞吐。: This page keeps process data for checking; it is not a memory-saving runtime and does not measure GPU throughput.
原书 24.8.2 的 w = 3 计算量是粗略估算：因果窗口下前两个位置的可见: The w = 3 cost in §24.8.2 of the Chinese original is a rough estimate: under a causal window the first two positions have fewer than 3 visible neighbours, so there are actually fewer pairs.
原书 24.8 只数主要矩阵乘法，是理论估算；本页同样只核对数学结果，不测量运行: §24.8 of the Chinese original counts only the main matrix multiplications as a theoretical estimate; likewise this page only checks the mathematical results and measures no run time.
归一化：缩放和概率是一回事吗？: Normalization: are scaling and probability the same thing?
这一页从原书 6.2.4 的四个数 [22, 5, 6, 8] 出发。你会亲手算: This page starts from the four numbers [22, 5, 6, 8] in §6.2.3 of the book. You'll work out the mean and variance yourself, use them for LayerNorm and RMSNorm, and then let softmax turn scores into probabilities. Finally, add the same number to the whole row and see which results change and which don't.
这一页想弄明白：一行数字怎样被整理到合适的尺度，或变成概率: The question here: how is a row of numbers brought to a suitable scale, or turned into probabilities?
先把一行数字拉回统一的尺度，再把分数变成概率。: First bring a row of numbers back to a common scale, then turn scores into probabilities.
为什么需要 LayerNorm 和 Softmax？: Why do we need LayerNorm and softmax?
数字经过一层又一层计算，可能越来越大或越来越小：太大会溢出，太小会丢精度。Lay: As numbers pass through layer after layer, they can grow ever larger or smaller: too large overflows, too small loses precision. In every block, LayerNorm pulls a token's vector back to a common scale so later layers can handle it more easily.
Softmax 解决另一件事：把一组可正可负的分数，变成“每项在 0 到 1 之: Softmax solves a different problem: it turns a set of scores that can be positive or negative into probabilities, each between 0 and 1 and summing to 1. Attention uses it to assign shares, and at the end the model also uses it to assign probabilities to the next token.
默认数字就是原书 6.2.4 的手算例子，可以直接与书中结果 [1.71, −0: The default numbers are the worked example from §6.2.3 of the book, so you can check directly against its result [1.71, −0.76, −0.62, −0.33].
同样是 70 公斤，用克记是 70000，用吨记是 0.07。数没有变，只是换了: 70 kilograms is 70000 in grams and 0.07 in tonnes. The quantity did not change; only the ruler did. LayerNorm gives each token's vector a suitable ruler.
第 6.1、6.2.1 节 · 为什么需要这两个工具: §6.1 Why These Two Tools Matter · §6.2.1 The Problem: Numbers Drift
先在这一行里算平均值和分散程度: First compute the average and the spread within this row
这四个数是同一个 token 的四个特征维 d0–d3。LayerNorm 只在: These four numbers are the four feature dimensions d0–d3 of a single token. LayerNorm computes its statistics within this row only, never mixing in other tokens. The mean μ = sum of the four numbers ÷ {#0} = {#1}; subtracting μ from each number, squaring and averaging gives the variance σ² = {#2}. This divides by D = {#3}, not by the D − 1 that statistics uses to estimate a sample variance.
改动另一个 token 的向量，需要重算这一行的 μ 和 σ² 吗？: If another token's vector changes, do this row's μ and σ² need recomputing?
每个 token 只用自己的特征算统计量；同一层的所有 token 共用同一组: Each token computes its statistics from its own features only; all tokens of a layer share one set of γ, β.
减去平均值，再除以标准差: Subtract the mean, then divide by the standard deviation
每个数先减去 μ，再除以同一个分母 $\\sqrt{\\sigma^2+\\ep: Each number first has μ subtracted and is then divided by the same denominator $\sqrt{\sigma^2+\epsilon}$ = {#0}. The result z has mean {#1} and variance {#2}: the numbers are pulled back near 0, but their order from small to large does not change. ε is a small number that prevents division by 0; set ε to 1 and the variance drops clearly below 1.
常量输入减去均值后是什么？为什么 z 的方差不一定正好是 1？: What does a constant input become after subtracting the mean? Why is the variance of z not necessarily exactly 1?
LayerNorm 让一行数的均值为 0、方差约为 1；数之间的相对位置不变。: LayerNorm gives a row of numbers mean 0 and variance about 1; the relative positions of the numbers stay the same.
RMSNorm：不减平均值，只除以均方根: RMSNorm: no mean subtracted, only divided by the root mean square
RMSNorm 省掉“减平均值”这一步，直接把每个数除以均方根 $\\sqrt{: RMSNorm skips “subtract the mean” and divides each number directly by the root mean square $\sqrt{\overline{x^2}+\epsilon}$ = {#0}. So 0 stays at 0 and negatives stay negative; the mean of the result is {#1}, generally not 0. Many open-source models (LLaMA, for example) use it instead of LayerNorm; chapter 6 of the book only covers LayerNorm, so this step is an added comparison.
给所有坐标加同一个常数，RMS 分母会怎样变化？: If the same constant is added to every coordinate, how does the RMS denominator change?
RMSNorm 只控制尺度、不做中心化，比 LayerNorm 少一步。: RMSNorm only controls scale and does no centering – one step fewer than LayerNorm.
第 6.2 节 · LayerNorm（RMSNorm 为补充对照）: §6.2 LayerNorm: Keep the Scale Reasonable (RMSNorm added for comparison)

Starting from the probability that one answer is better than another, take DPO, PPO's clipping and GRPO's within-group advantages apart step by step. Only the objectives from the published papers are checked here; no model is actually trained.

“这个回答更好”这句话，怎样一步步变成可以计算的训练目标。: How the sentence “this answer is better” turns, step by step, into a training objective you can compute.

SSM 与 Mamba：过去怎样进入当前状态？: SSM and Mamba: how does the past get into the current state?
先从只有一个数的状态开始：每来一个输入，旧状态衰减一点，新信息写进去一点。然后让: Start with a state that is just one number: with every new input, the old state fades a little and a little new information is written in. Then let the step size, the write and the read-out depend on the input – that's Mamba's “selectivity”. Finally, see what happens when a fixed-size state can't hold all of the history.
这一页想弄明白：不回头读取全部历史，过去怎样进入当前状态: The question here: without rereading the whole history, how does the past get into the current state?
不回头翻历史，只带着一个不断更新的小状态往前走。: Don't leaf back through the history; just carry a small, constantly updated state forward.
不用 Attention，模型还能怎样记住前文？: Without attention, how else can a model remember what came before?
Attention 每一步都回头读取全部历史，序列越长，计算和 KV 缓存越大（: Attention reads the whole history again at every step, so the longer the sequence, the larger the computation and the KV cache (§32.1 of the book). RNNs take a different route: a “hidden state” compresses the history, and each step needs only the previous state and the current input.
SSM（状态空间模型）沿用这个思路；Mamba 再让状态的更新方式随输入变化：重: SSMs (state space models) follow this idea; Mamba goes further and lets the way the state is updated depend on the input: important inputs are written into the state more, unimportant ones less. This page works through the process by hand with a single scalar state.
用同样的注意力读每个字（32.3.2）: Reading every word with the same attention (§32.3.2)
传统 SSM 对 “The” 和 “fox” 用同样的参数，就像一个人用同样的注: A classic SSM uses the same parameters for “The” and for “fox”, like someone reading every word with the same attention and unable to tell important from unimportant. Mamba's selective parameters let it decide by content what to remember and what to forget.
把过去折进一个数，再读出输出: Fold the past into one number, then read out the output
本页的状态 h 只是一个数。每读一个输入，先把旧状态乘一个保留系数，再加上这次写: The state h on this page is just one number. For each input, the old state is first multiplied by a keep factor, then this step's write is added; the output is read from the current state. Initial h = {#0}; with fixed parameters the four states are {#1}. The model keeps this one aggregated state, not a list of history.
新输入到来时，保存的是历史列表还是一个聚合状态？: When a new input arrives, is a list of history kept, or one aggregated state?
状态是过去的压缩表示；读出时不能直接访问全部历史。: The state is a compressed representation of the past; reading out cannot access the whole history directly.
Mamba：步长 Δ、写入 B、读出 C 随输入变化: Mamba: step size Δ, write B and read-out C depend on the input
输入相关模式下，每个时间步的 Δ、B、C 都由当前输入算出；当前四步的 Δ 为: In input-dependent mode, Δ, B and C of every time step are computed from the current input; the current four Δ are {#0}. The larger Δ, the more this step “attends to the current input”; the smaller Δ, the more it “keeps the history” (§32.3.2 of the book). A always stays fixed; the projection rules here are this page's teaching setup, not Mamba's trained weights.
把输入改大，会同时影响哪些系数？: If an input gets larger, which coefficients does it affect at once?
选择性来自参数对输入的依赖，不是预设的语义开关。: Selectivity comes from the parameters depending on the input, not from a predefined meaning switch.
离散化：Δ 同时决定留多少旧的、写多少新的: Discretization: Δ decides both how much old state stays and how much new input is written
连续形式的 A、B 要换成一步一步的系数：旧状态乘 $e^{\\Delta A}: The continuous A and B have to become per-step coefficients: the old state is multiplied by $e^{\Delta A}$ and the new input by $\bar B$. The current four keep factors are {#0}. With A < 0, the larger Δ, the less old state is kept and the more new input is written. This page computes with expm1 to avoid losing precision when subtracting close numbers; with A = 0 it takes the limit ΔB.
为什么 Δ 变化时，新输入的写入系数也要跟着变？: Why must the write coefficient for new input change too when Δ changes?
离散化同时改变保留项和写入项，不能只改其中一个。: Discretization changes the keep term and the write term together; you cannot change just one of them.
一步一步扫：每一步只用上一步的状态: Scan step by step: each step uses only the previous step's state
看第 {#0} 步：上一状态 {#1} × 保留 {#2} + 写入 {#3}: Look at step {#0}: previous state {#1} × keep {#2} + write {#3} = {#4}. Drag “time step t to view” and the figure shows the states step by step; future states have not been computed yet. Changing input 2 only affects the state at step 2 and after.
如果改动第 2 个输入，之前的输出会被改变吗？: If input 2 changes, do earlier outputs change?
时间方向的依赖决定了哪些结果需要重算。: The dependency along time decides which results need recomputing.
Δ 越大，旧状态忘得越快: The larger Δ, the faster the old state is forgotten
基础步长 Δ = {#0}。A < 0 时，保留系数 $e^{\\Delta A: Base step size Δ = {#0}. With A < 0 the keep factor $e^{\Delta A}$ gets smaller as Δ grows: a large Δ makes the old state decay faster and attend more to the current input, a small Δ stays closer to keeping the old state. §32.3.4 of the Chinese original says “small Δ forgets quickly”, which contradicts the formula and its own §32.3.3; this page follows the formula (the English edition, §32.3.2, has it right).
旧状态衰减得更快，是否意味着当前输出一定更小？: If the old state decays faster, must the current output be smaller?
保留系数只描述旧状态；新输入的写入量也在同时变化。: The keep factor describes only the old state; the amount of new input written changes at the same time.
第 32.3.4 节 · 选择性机制的力量（本页已修正）: §32.3.4 Why Selection Matters for Language (corrected on this page)
固定大小的状态：不同的历史可能变成同一个数: A fixed-size state: different histories can become the same number
表中两段不同的历史，用固定参数扫描后最终状态都是 {#0}，之后的计算再也分不清: The two different histories in the table both end in the state {#0} after a scan with fixed parameters, and later computation can no longer tell them apart. Causal attention, by contrast, reads the whole history directly every time – a different mechanism. Finally, predict: if only the base step size changes, does the keep factor of the old state change?
相同的最终状态能区分所有历史细节吗？: Can the same final state distinguish every detail of history?
Mamba 的选择性 SSM 更灵活，但固定大小的状态不代表能无损记住任意长历史: Mamba's selective SSM is more flexible, but a fixed-size state does not mean an arbitrarily long history is remembered losslessly.
第 32.8 节 · Transformer vs Mamba vs Hybri: §32.8 Architecture Selection Guide (Transformer vs Mamba vs hybrid)
只改变基础步长，旧状态保留系数会保持不变吗？: If only the base step size changes, does the keep factor of the old state stay the same?
旧状态保留系数: keep factor of the old state
原书第 32 章 · 后 Transformer 架构: Chapter 32 · Post-Transformer Architectures – Mamba and Hybrid Models
标量选择性 SSM 机制示例；省略 Mamba 的卷积、门控、扩展投影与多维状态: An example of the scalar selective SSM mechanism; Mamba's convolution, gating, expansion projections and multi-dimensional state are left out, so it cannot be called a full reproduction of the model.
固定参数历史碰撞只证明本示例映射的边界；不作为所有任务的架构优劣排序。: The history collision with fixed parameters only shows the limit of this example's mapping; it is not a ranking of architectures for every task.
序列扫描、额外状态空间和 Attention 历史访问分别讨论；没有真实硬件性能: The sequential scan, the extra state space and attention's access to history are discussed separately; there are no real hardware performance measurements.
原书 32.3.4 写“对 The（冠词）：小 Δ → 快速遗忘”。按 $\\b: §32.3.4 of the Chinese original says “for The (an article): small Δ → forget quickly”. With $\bar A = e^{\Delta A}$ (A < 0), a small Δ brings the keep factor close to 1 and keeps more of the old state; only a large Δ makes the old state decay faster. That matches the book's own §32.3.3, “when Δ is very small the hidden state stays stable”, and this page follows the formula. The English edition (§32.3.2) states it correctly.
没有位置信息，Attention 分不清“我爱你”和“你爱我”: Without position information, attention cannot tell “man bites dog” from “dog bites man”
Attention 只看“有哪些向量”，不看“谁排第几”；顺序必须另外加进去。: Attention only sees “which vectors are there”, not “who comes in which place”; order has to be added separately.
为什么两句话里“我”的输出完全一样？因果 Mask 能不能单独解决这个问题？: Why is the output for “man” exactly the same in both sentences? Can the causal mask solve this on its own?
正弦位置编码：每个位置一组不同快慢的“指针”: Sinusoidal positional encoding: a set of “clock hands” turning at different speeds for each position
每对维度是一根转速不同的指针：低维转得快，高维转得慢，合起来给每个位置一组独特的: Each pair of dimensions is a hand turning at its own speed: low dimensions turn fast, high dimensions slowly, and together they give every position its own unique “house number”.
第 $i$ 对维度每前进一个位置转多少？为什么同一对里的 $\\sin$ 和 $: How far does the $i$-th pair of dimensions turn per position? Why do the $\sin$ and $\cos$ of one pair share a frequency?
相加：位置在进入第一个 Block 之前加到 X 上: Addition: the position is added to X before the first block
加法发生在投影之前：X 变了，Q、K、V 三条支路都带上了位置。: The addition happens before the projections: X changes, so all three branches – Q, K and V – carry position.
两个“L”的嵌入相同，为什么相加后不同？位置信息会不会进入 V？: The two “L”s have the same embedding; why are they different after the addition? Does position information reach V?
RoPE：不加到 X 上，而是把 Q、K 按位置旋转: RoPE: instead of adding to X, rotate Q and K by position
RoPE 在投影之后旋转 Q 和 K；长度不变，V 不旋转。: RoPE rotates Q and K after projection; lengths stay the same, and V is not rotated.
RoPE 作用在哪两个量上？旋转会改变向量长度吗？V 为什么不用转？: Which two quantities does RoPE act on? Does the rotation change vector length? Why is V not rotated?
同时平移两个位置，RoPE 分数不变: Shift both positions together and the RoPE score stays the same
内容固定时，$(R_m q)\\cdot(R_n k)$ 只取决于 $n-m$；: With fixed content, $(R_m q)\cdot(R_n k)$ depends only on $n-m$; but it rises and falls with distance and does not decrease monotonically.
为什么 $R_m^{\\top}R_n = R_{n-m}$？“分数只看相对距离: Why does $R_m^{\top}R_n = R_{n-m}$ hold? What conditions does “the score only depends on relative distance” need?
ALiBi：不改 Q、K、V，只在分数上减去距离惩罚: ALiBi: leave Q, K, V alone and subtract a distance penalty from the scores
ALiBi 把 $-m\\cdot\\text{距离}$ 加到 Softmax: ALiBi adds $-m\cdot\text{distance}$ to the scores before softmax; the steeper the slope, the more attention stays nearby.
ALiBi 改的是哪个矩阵？为什么每个头的斜率不同？能算更长序列意味着什么、不意: Which matrix does ALiBi change? Why does each head have a different slope? What does being able to compute longer sequences mean – and not mean?
三种方法，分别在计算的哪一步加入顺序: Three methods, and the step of the computation where each adds order
加法改 X（影响 Q、K、V），RoPE 改 Q、K，ALiBi 改分数。: Addition changes X (affecting Q, K and V), RoPE changes Q and K, ALiBi changes the scores.
不看图，说出三种方法各自加在哪一步、改变了哪些量、V 是否带有位置。: Without looking at the figure, say where each method is added, which quantities it changes, and whether V carries position.

Attention Is All You Need · §3.5 位置编码: Attention Is All You Need · §3.5 Positional Encoding
第 5 章的位置表是 $d_{\\mathrm{model}} = 64$ 时的: In the Chinese original, the position table of chapter 5 shows the first 4 dimensions for $d_{\mathrm{model}} = 64$, truncated (not rounded) to two decimals: e.g. $\sin 2 = 0.909\ldots$ is printed as 0.90. This page keeps 3 decimals and rounds, so a few cells differ by 0.01.
第 5.3.2 节说 Col 6 频率最低、Col 9 最高。按公式，同一对 $: Section 5.3.2 of the Chinese original says Col 6 has the lowest frequency and Col 9 the highest. By the formula, the $\sin$/$\cos$ of one pair share a frequency and higher dimensions have lower frequency; the book's own wave plot also shows Col 6 and 7 turning faster than Col 8 and 9.
第 25.3.6 节的 $\\theta = 0.1$、0.2、0.4 是示意数: The $\theta = 0.1$, 0.2, 0.4 in section 25.3.6 of the Chinese original are illustrative. By $\theta_i = 10000^{-2i/d}$, $\theta$ shrinks as $i$ grows; this page uses $d = 8$, so $\theta$ is exactly 1, 0.1, 0.01, 0.001.
第 25.3.8 节说相邻 token 能获得更高注意力。RoFormer 论文: Section 25.3.8 of the Chinese original says neighbouring tokens get more attention. The RoFormer paper proves that an upper bound decays with distance; a single score can rise and fall with distance – see the curve in the “Relative distance” step.
每个 Query 与可见 Key 打分，按权重汇总 Value；因果 Mask: Each Query scores visible Keys and combines Values; causal masking preserves directional dependencies.
Decode 保留每层历史 K/V，缓存随 token 数增长。FlashAtt: Decode retains per-layer historical K/V, growing with token count. FlashAttention avoids full score intermediates without eliminating the KV cache.
训练可并行算各位置；Decode 的新 Query 仍读取历史。表达能力和实际性: Training computes positions in parallel; each new Decode Query still reads history. Capabilities and performance depend on the configuration.
在同一序列内使用固定状态转移与读写规则；递推可以展开为卷积。固定规则仍可在训练中: Use fixed transition/read/write rules within a sequence; recurrence can expand into a convolution. Those rules can still be learned during training.
递归推理维护固定大小状态；卷积训练的工作区与激活需要另算。: Recurrent inference maintains fixed-size state; convolution-training workspace and activations require separate accounting.
固定参数时可利用卷积组织并行训练。把参数改成输入相关后，一般不能沿用同一个全局卷: Fixed parameters permit convolutional training; input-dependent parameters generally prevent reusing one global convolution kernel.
Δ、B、C 随当前输入变化；短卷积、选择性 SSM、门控和输出投影一起组成 Bl: Δ, B and C depend on current input; a short convolution, selective SSM, gate and output projection form the block.
逐步生成保留 SSM 状态和短卷积历史；大小由通道、状态维和卷积宽度决定。: Stepwise generation retains SSM state and short-convolution history, sized by channels, state width and convolution width.
有递推依赖不等于只能串行训练：仿射状态更新可用并行 scan 组合。固定大小状态: Recurrence does not force serial training: affine state updates compose through parallel scans. Fixed-size state does not guarantee lossless history.
SSD 对状态转移增加结构约束，用递推形式与结构化矩阵形式描述相关计算，并组织高: SSD adds structure to state transitions, relating recurrent and structured-matrix forms and enabling efficient chunked algorithms.
保留跨块状态；块内可使用矩阵乘法。数学上写出完整矩阵不要求实现中保存它。: Retain cross-chunk state and use matrix multiplication within chunks; a mathematical full matrix need not be stored by the implementation.
这种联系针对受约束的 SSM 与结构化 Attention；不能推成任意 SSM: The connection concerns constrained SSMs and structured attention; it does not equate arbitrary SSMs with standard Softmax attention.
用 time-mixing、带衰减的 Key/Value 聚合和 recepta: Model sequences using time-mixing, decaying Key/Value aggregation and a receptance gate; this entry refers to the 2023 paper version.
递归生成维护聚合状态，无需按原样保留所有历史 K/V。状态含义和大小随 RWKV: Recurrent generation maintains aggregates instead of storing all historical K/V directly; state meaning and size vary across RWKV versions.
训练与递归推理可以采用不同计算组织；它不等同于把普通 Softmax Atten: Training and recurrent inference use different computation organizations; this is not simply a rewrite of ordinary Softmax attention.
Retention 用多尺度衰减控制历史贡献，并保留读出所需的聚合矩阵状态。: Retention controls historical contributions with multiscale decay while retaining an aggregate matrix state for readout.
支持并行、递归、分块递归三种计算形式；生成状态不随已处理 token 数逐项追加: Supports parallel, recurrent and chunkwise recurrent forms; generation state does not append an entry for every processed token.
应比较同一机制的不同计算形式，再讨论与 Softmax Attention 的表: First compare different forms of the same mechanism, then its expressive differences from Softmax attention; arrows or big-O labels alone are insufficient.
将隐式参数化的长卷积与数据相关的逐元素门控交替组合，作为序列混合算子。: Alternate implicitly parameterized long convolutions with data-controlled elementwise gating as a sequence mixer.
长卷积可利用 FFT 等算法；不能仅凭“卷积”就假定拥有与标量 SSM 相同的固: Long convolutions can use FFT algorithms; convolution alone does not imply the same fixed recurrent cache as a scalar SSM.
需说明过滤器参数化、门控及具体实现；本页提供机制定位，没有运行完整 Hyena: Specify filter parameterization, gates and implementation; this page locates the mechanism without running a full Hyena model.
混合序列层，独立配置专家: Mix sequence layers; configure experts separately
Attention 层与 Mamba 层交错；某些层的 MLP 再替换为 MoE: Interleave attention and Mamba layers; replace some MLPs with MoE. Mixer ratio and expert configuration are separate design axes.
Attention 层仍需 KV 缓存，Mamba 层保留状态与卷积历史；两者一: Attention layers still need KV caches; Mamba layers retain state and convolution history, both included in history storage.
原始 Jamba 发布配置的 Attention:Mamba 比为 1:7。保留: The original released Jamba uses an attention:Mamba ratio of 1:7. Hybrid models with full attention retain a quadratic pairwise term and cannot universally be called O(T).
X 是逐 token 归一化后的分支输入；本图选择 LayerNorm，作者实现: X is the branch input normalized per token; this diagram chooses LayerNorm, while the author implementation also supports RMSNorm. Normalization acts on features.
X 是归一化后的输入 [T,D]；W_in 将其扩维并分成 u、z 两支，各为: X is normalized input [T,D]; W_in expands and splits it into u and z branches, each [T,D_inner].
T 是 token 数，D 是隐藏维，D_inner 是扩展通道数，N 是每通道: T is tokens, D hidden width, D_inner expanded channels and N state dimensions per channel.
DWConv 是逐通道短因果卷积，只读当前及之前位置；v 是卷积后经 SiLU: DWConv is a short depthwise causal convolution over current and past positions; v is its SiLU-activated main-branch output.
由当前主分支输入 vₜ 生成步长 Δₜ、写入 Bₜ 和读出 Cₜ；本式的线性投影: Current branch input vₜ produces step Δₜ, write Bₜ and read Cₜ; the linear projection parameters stay fixed during the forward pass.
本式用单通道行向量：hₜ 为 [1,N]，Āₜ 为 [N,N]，B̄ₜ 为 [1: For one channel in row-vector notation: hₜ is [1,N], Āₜ [N,N], B̄ₜ [1,N], Cₜ [N,1], while vₜ and yₜ are scalars. Bars denote discretized coefficients.
y 是 SSM 主分支输出，z 是投影时分出的门控支路；⊙ 表示同形状张量逐元素: y is SSM output, z the gate branch split at projection; ⊙ multiplies equal-shaped tensors elementwise to produce g.
W_out 将扩展通道压回 D 维；F 是送回残差主路的分支输出 [T,D]。: W_out contracts expanded channels back to D; F is the branch output [T,D] added to the residual stream.
X_res 是归一化之前的残差输入；X_next 是原输入加分支 F 后的下一层: X_res is the residual input before normalization; X_next is the next representation after adding branch F.
a 是每步保留比例，xₜ 是当前位置标量输入，hₜ 是更新后状态；本例初始 h₋: a is per-step retention, xₜ the current scalar input, hₜ the updated state; h₋₁=0 initially and write/read coefficients both equal 1.
L 的行 t 是输出位置，列 j 是输入位置，未来项为 0；x、y 在这里都是: Rows t of L are output positions and columns j input positions; future entries are 0. x and y are [1,4] row vectors, hence y=xLᵀ.
依次为批大小、Attention 层数、token 数、KV 头数、Key/Va: Batch size, attention layers, tokens, KV heads, Key/Value width per head, and bytes per element.
L_S 是 SSM 层数；每通道 N 个状态，加 k−1 个因果短卷积历史。本账: L_S is SSM layer count; each channel keeps N state values and k−1 causal-convolution history values. Only history state is counted, not weights or other workspace.
先把已经归一化的 X 投影到两倍扩展宽度，再沿特征维分成主分支 u 和门控支路: Project normalized X to twice the inner width, then split features into main branch u and gate branch z. Both keep the same token order.
短卷积在每个扩展通道内混合相邻位置，为主分支加入局部信息；生成时需要保留有限个过: A short convolution mixes neighboring positions within each expanded channel, adding local information; generation retains a finite history of convolution inputs.
Δ、B、C 是当前输入算出的激活，不是每读一个 token 就训练出新参数。连续: Δ, B and C are input-derived activations, not freshly trained parameters at every token. Continuous A stays fixed during the sequence forward, while discretized Ā still varies with Δ.
每个通道把过去压入 N 维状态。顺序形式便于逐 token 生成；训练可以利用仿: Each channel compresses history into N state dimensions. Sequential form suits generation; affine update associativity permits parallel training scans despite recurrent dependencies.
SSM 输出与另一支输入投影的 SiLU 结果逐元素相乘。这里的门作用于特征，不: Multiply SSM output elementwise by SiLU of the other projected branch. This gate acts on features rather than Top-K expert routing.
把扩展通道压回隐藏维数 D，得到可以与原输入相加的分支。这个投影与 SSM 内部: Contract inner channels to hidden width D so the branch can be added to the input. This projection differs from the SSM’s internal C readout.
本图采用预归一化的残差包装：分支读取归一化后的输入，最后加回未经这次归一化替换的: This diagram uses a Pre-Norm residual wrapper: the branch reads normalized input and adds back to the original residual input. It illustrates Mamba-1, not every Mamba version.
先找出这一段文本的 UTF-8 字节。非 ASCII 字符可能由多个字节组成，表: Start with the UTF-8 bytes of the text. A non-ASCII character can span multiple bytes. The groups below preserve their original order.
为什么一个汉字或表情符号可能占多个字节？: Why can a Chinese character or emoji take several bytes?
字节总数与第 i 个字节: Total bytes and byte at index i
在训练语料的每个片段内统计相邻对。取频次最高的一对，从左到右做不重叠替换，再重新: Count adjacent pairs within each piece of the training corpus. Replace the most frequent pair from left to right without overlap, then count again. Ties go to the lower left ID, then the lower right ID.
在 aaa 中，为什么 aa 能被数到两次，却只能替换一次？: Why is aa counted twice in aaa but replaced only once?
被选中的相邻 token ID 对: Selected pair of adjacent token IDs
相邻对在当前语料中的出现次数: Number of occurrences of the pair in the current corpus
输入沿用语料中学到的规则，按学习顺序依次应用。切换当前轮可以看到哪些相邻字节或子: Apply the rules learned from the corpus in their learned order. Step through the rounds to see which adjacent bytes or subwords join. The input text does not contribute to the training counts.
有一条训练规则不出现在这段文本里时，这一轮会发生什么？: What happens in a round when its learned pair never occurs in the input?
依次连接字节序列: Concatenate the byte sequences in order
用每个 token ID 单独取出嵌入表的一行。位置是序列的行号，ID 是表的行: Use each token ID to look up one row of the embedding table. The sequence position indexes the output, while the ID indexes the table. Repeated IDs retrieve the same vector from a fixed table.
两个位置的 ID 相同，加入位置编码之前，它们的 Embedding 行是否相同: If two positions have the same ID, are their embedding rows identical before adding position information?

m 保存已见分数的最大值，l 保存相对 m 的指数之和，a 保存同样指数加权的: m keeps the largest score seen, l the sum of exponentials relative to m, and a the sum of V weighted by the same exponentials. When a new block raises the maximum to m′, exp(m − m′) brings the old l and old a onto the same basis before the new block's contribution is added. Finally a / l gives the full row's output. The block size only changes the grouping and the order of floating-point sums. Keeping temporary state on chip block by block avoids writing the full S and P back to HBM; the pairwise computation of full attention still grows quadratically with sequence length. 训练时整条序列已知，把它错开一位当作目标；因果 Mask 保证第 t 行只读 x: In training the whole sequence is known, so it is shifted by one to serve as the target; the causal mask ensures row t reads only x0…xt, so one forward pass gives the predictions and losses for all positions. At inference the next input waits for this step's output, so it goes one step at a time. Prefill processes the prompt in parallel and writes the K and V of every layer and position into the cache; each later decode step computes Q, K, V only for the new token, appends K and V to the cache, and reads the whole history with the new Q. The outputs of old Q were finished long ago, so Q is not stored. Cache and recompute give the same result; what is saved is the repeated projection and scoring. Changing token j invalidates only position j in layer 1, while higher layers must recompute from j on; if all position indices shift, no old entry can be reused directly.

The weights are fixed teaching numbers, not a trained model; a training step only computes the forward pass and the loss, with no backpropagation or parameter update. KV 缓存 = 批大小 × 层数 × token 数 × KV 头数 × (d_: KV cache = batch size × layers × tokens × KV heads × (d_k + d_v) × bytes per number, counting only K and V. In MHA each query head has its own K and V; GQA lets the query heads of a group share one, and MQA is the special case with a single group. What they reduce is KV heads; the number of query heads, W_Q, W_O and the number of scores stay the same. MLA does not reduce heads; it caches a low-dimensional latent from which each head's K and V are rebuilt when needed. If RoPE were applied to the rebuilt K, a position-dependent rotation would sit between the query and the latent and could not be absorbed, so DeepSeek-V2 sends position information through its own branch, and the shared RoPE key is cached too. Matrix absorption uses associativity to merge the matrix that rebuilds K into the query and the matrix that rebuilds V into the output projection; it changes only the order of computation, not the result.

输入先乘 Router 权重，再沿专家轴做 Softmax。取分数最大的 K 个: The input is first multiplied by the router weights, then softmax runs along the expert axis. The K experts with the highest scores are taken, and in this example the gates are renormalized within the selected set. Each selected expert runs a two-layer ReLU FFN; the results are weighted by the gate values and summed by token identity. Changing an expert's output does not change the routing of this forward pass. Attention 打分只用到两个向量的点积。如果输入只有词嵌入，“我”放在第: Attention scoring uses nothing but the dot product of two vectors. If the input is only word embeddings, “man” is the same vector whether it sits at position 0 or position 2; reverse the sentence and every word still sees the same set of vectors, just in another order. As a result, the model cannot tell “man bites dog” from “dog bites man”.
原始 Transformer 用 $\\sin$ 和 $\\cos$ 给每个位置: The original Transformer builds a vector for each position out of $\sin$ and $\cos$: the $i$-th pair of dimensions turns at frequency $\omega_i = 10000^{-2i/d_{\mathrm{model}}}$. Low dimensions turn fast and separate neighbouring positions; high dimensions turn slowly and separate positions far apart. All values stay in $[-1, 1]$ instead of growing like integer position numbers.
位置向量与词嵌入逐维相加（不是拼接），维度仍是 $d_{\\mathrm{mod: The position vector is added to the word embedding dimension by dimension (not concatenated), so the size stays $d_{\mathrm{model}}$. This happens before the first block: the later $W_Q$, $W_K$, $W_V$ all act on the summed X, so Q, K and V all carry position. The sine table is fixed; the embedding table is updated during training.
RoPE（LLaMA 等模型使用）不再把位置加到 X 上。投影得到 Q、K 之后: RoPE (used by LLaMA and other models) no longer adds position to X. After the projections produce Q and K, they are grouped into pairs of dimensions and each pair is rotated by $m\theta_i$ according to position. Rotation changes direction but not length; V is not rotated.
两个向量各自转了 $m\\theta_i$ 与 $n\\theta_i$，它们的: The two vectors are rotated by $m\theta_i$ and $n\theta_i$; their dot product depends only on the angle between them, and the change in that angle depends only on $(n-m)\theta_i$. So shifting both positions together leaves the score unchanged: that is “relative position”.
ALiBi（BLOOM、MPT 等使用）连 Q、K 都不动：算出 $QK^{\\: ALiBi (used by BLOOM, MPT and others) does not even touch Q and K: after computing $QK^{\top}/\sqrt{d}$, each key loses $m\times\text{distance}$ according to its distance from the query, then softmax runs. Each head uses a different slope $m$: some heads only look nearby, others are hardly affected by distance.

横轴是距离 n − m，纵轴是固定内容下的 q′·k′。同一距离的所有 (m,: The horizontal axis is the distance n − m, the vertical axis q′·k′ for fixed content. All (m, n) with the same distance land on the same point; but the curve rises and falls – the score at distance 5 is higher than at distance 0.
成立条件：q、k 的内容固定，{#0}、{#1} 用同一套 {#2} 旋转。真实: Conditions: the content of q and k is fixed, and {#0} and {#1} use the same set of {#2}. In a real model, changing the token also changes the content vectors, and the score changes with them.
ALiBi 偏置 m·B，行是 Query，列是 Key: ALiBi bias m·B; rows are queries, columns are keys
书中 25.4.2 的偏置矩阵 [0; −1 0; −2 −1 0; …] 乘以: The bias matrix [0; −1 0; −2 −1 0; …] from the book's ALiBi section, multiplied by m; the upper right is the causal mask. Click a row label to choose the query.
内容分数加偏置后再 Softmax: content score plus bias, then softmax
彩色条是加偏置后的权重，灰色条是不加 ALiBi 的权重。: Coloured bars are the weights with the bias, grey bars the weights without ALiBi.
先预测：在最后一个 token“师”这一行，{#0}和 {#1}，哪个头给最近的: Predict first: in the row of the last token “r”, which head – {#0} or {#1} – gives more weight to the nearest position, itself?
预测哪个头更关注附近: Predict which head focuses more on nearby positions
{#0}head 1 给“师”自己 {#1}%，head 8 只给 {#2}%。: {#0}head 1 gives “r” itself {#1}%, head 8 only {#2}%. The steeper the slope, the more distant positions are penalized and the more attention stays nearby; a head with a small slope looks almost only at the content scores.
Q、K、V 都没有改变，ALiBi 只在 Softmax 之前给分数加偏置。偏置: Q, K and V are all unchanged; ALiBi only adds a bias to the scores before softmax. The bias depends only on distance, so it can be computed for any length; but “able to compute longer sequences” does not mean the model can reliably use a longer context.
X → Q、K、V 全部: X → all of Q, K, V
分数只看相对距离: score depends only on relative distance
Softmax 前，加到分数: before softmax, added to the scores
位置编码不是把 1、2、3 直接加上去：书中 5.2 节的整数方案数值会越加越大: Positional encoding does not simply add 1, 2, 3: with the integer scheme of §5.2 the values keep growing and there is no pattern to learn.
RoPE 不加到 X 上，也不旋转 V；ALiBi 不改 Q、K、V，只改分数。: RoPE is not added to X and does not rotate V; ALiBi does not change Q, K, V, only the scores.
RoPE 的“相对位置”成立需要固定内容、同一套 {#0}；单个分数并不随距离单: RoPE's “relative position” needs fixed content and the same set of {#0}; a single score does not fall monotonically with distance.
能计算更远的位置，不等于模型能可靠处理任意长的上下文（外推还取决于训练长度与方法: Being able to compute more distant positions does not mean the model can reliably handle arbitrarily long context (extrapolation also depends on training length and method).
逐 token 升维：二维输入变成三维特征: Expand per token: 2-D input becomes 3-D features
非线性决定哪些坐标继续传递: The nonlinearity decides which coordinates pass on
关闭 ReLU 后，两次线性变换可合并；启用后一般不成立。: With ReLU off, the two linear maps can be merged; with it on, generally not.
独立的降维投影回到残差维度: A separate down-projection back to the residual dimension
残差把原输入逐项加回来: The residual adds the original input back entry by entry
梯度包含恒等支路 I；这不保证总梯度永不消失，其他支路可能抵消。此 Jacobi: The gradient contains the identity path I; this does not guarantee the total gradient never vanishes, since other paths can cancel it. This Jacobian is for the residual without dropout.
训练随机屏蔽并补偿；推理直接通过: Training masks at random and compensates; inference passes straight through
采用 inverted Dropout：训练保留项除以 1−p，残差支路不丢弃。: Uses inverted dropout: kept entries are divided by 1−p during training, and the residual branch is never dropped. The fixed seed is only for reproducibility.
两层线性可以合并，非线性通常不能: Two linear layers can be merged; with a nonlinearity they usually cannot
切换 ReLU 与运行模式；不是所有输入都一定能暴露非线性差异。: Toggle ReLU and the run mode; not every input necessarily reveals the nonlinear difference.
线性支路的两种计算次序等价: The two orders of computation of the linear branch are equivalent
推理 Dropout 为恒等: dropout at inference is the identity
冻结的底座仍做完整线性投影: The frozen base still does the full linear projection
冻结表示不更新参数；不表示省掉它的前向计算或权重存储。: Frozen means the parameters are not updated; it does not mean skipping its forward computation or its weight storage.
低秩支路先压到 r 维，再投影回来: The low-rank branch first squeezes to r dimensions, then projects back
行向量约定：ΔW = (α/r)AB。这里用非零教学参数演示已存在的更新，没有训: Row-vector convention: ΔW = (α/r)AB. Non-zero teaching parameters show an update that already exists; there is no training loop.
把更新支路加到原输出: Add the update branch to the original output
rank 约束的是更新，不是底座的无损压缩: Rank constrains the update; it is not a lossless compression of the base
二维玩具的 rank=2 已无参数节省；真实 d 很大、r 很小时才体现低秩参数: In this 2-D toy, rank = 2 already saves no parameters; the low-rank advantage only shows when the real d is large and r small. Changing r also changes this example's update, and quality is not decided by rank alone.
量化底座加高精度适配器：QLoRA 的数据流: A quantized base plus a high-precision adapter: QLoRA's data flow
真实 QLoRA 用 NF4 存储底座，通常用 BF16 计算与适配器训练；本页: Real QLoRA stores the base in NF4 and usually computes and trains the adapter in BF16; this page substitutes uniform 4-bit and JS float64 and only explains the division of labour. Double quantization, paged optimizers and full training are not reproduced.
分别统计底座存储、适配器与计算: Count base storage, adapter and compute separately
底座冻结，A/B 可训练；示例所有运算使用 JS float64，账本假设 4B: The base is frozen and A/B are trainable; all arithmetic in the example uses JS float64, and the ledger assumes a 4 B adapter – not a real GPU dtype or memory measurement.
双支路与合并权重输出等价: two branches and merged weights give the same output
完整因果 Attention 访问所有可见历史: Full causal attention accesses all visible history
因果滑动窗口只保留最近 w 个 Key: A causal sliding window keeps only the latest w keys
本页用稠密矩阵加 Mask 验证数学；只有相应稀疏实现才能减少实际计算。: This page verifies the math with a dense matrix plus a mask; only a matching sparse implementation reduces the actual computation.
换成正核特征，定义另一种 Attention: Switching to positive kernel features defines a different attention
核归一化不是标准 Softmax 的恒等重写，输出一般不同。: Kernel normalization is not an identity rewrite of standard softmax; the outputs generally differ.
核权重可通过固定大小 S、z 状态递推: Kernel weights can be computed by recurrence on fixed-size states S and z
包含当前 Key 后再读取。固定特征维度时扫描对 T 线性；本页额外保存轨迹以便: The current key is included before reading. With a fixed feature dimension the scan is linear in T; this page additionally keeps a trace for checking.
Infini：先读上一段记忆，再合并本段局部结果: Infini: first read the previous segment's memory, then combine with this segment's local result
上一段记忆读出: read from the previous segment's memory
每段 2 token；整段更新都读取同一个旧记忆。初始空记忆返回零。Delta: 2 tokens per segment; the whole segment's update reads the same old memory. The initial empty memory returns zero. The delta update predicts V and writes the residual; z still accumulates.
两段不同历史，可以压缩到同一个状态: Two different histories can be compressed into the same state
二者相同的最终 S: the final S, identical for both
这说明此压缩映射有碰撞。可计算长流不代表无损保存所有历史，也不保证任意长上下文的: This shows the compression map has collisions. Being able to compute a long stream does not mean every past detail is kept losslessly, nor that arbitrarily long context is handled reliably.
线性递推与显式核基线等价: the linear recurrence equals the explicit kernel baseline
不同历史的压缩状态碰撞: compressed states of different histories collide
同一把尺：减去 μ 只是整体平移，点之间的距离不变: One ruler for all: subtracting μ only shifts everything, the distances between points stay the same
各行各用一把尺：除以 σ 后，原来的 ±σ 落到 ±1 附近，点的相对位置不变: Each row with its own ruler: after dividing by σ, the old ±σ lands near ±1, the relative positions of the points stay the same
各行各用一把尺：RMSNorm 不平移，只按同一个分母缩放，0 的位置不动: Each row with its own ruler: RMSNorm does not shift, it only scales by one denominator, and 0 stays where it is
沿特征轴统计，同一 token 的四个坐标: statistics along the feature axis, the four coordinates of one token
中心化后，除以标准差与 ε 构成的分母: centered, then divided by the denominator built from the standard deviation and ε
ε > 0 时方差通常略小于 1；常量向量的 z 为 0。: With ε > 0 the variance is usually slightly below 1; a constant vector gives z = 0.
RMSNorm 不减均值，保留原向量的符号: RMSNorm does not subtract the mean and keeps the signs of the original vector
逐坐标缩放；本例只编辑第 0 维参数: scaled coordinate by coordinate; this example only edits the parameters of dimension 0
γ、β 是可训练参数；这里仅做前向干预，没有优化器更新。: γ and β are trainable parameters; here they are only changed in the forward pass, with no optimizer update.
同一组数现在作为候选分数，沿候选轴 Softmax: The same numbers now serve as candidate scores; softmax runs along the candidate axis
全部屏蔽：数学上没有合法分布，本工具返回全零并明确标记。: All masked: mathematically there is no valid distribution; this tool returns all zeros and marks it clearly.
减去最大值保证指数不溢出；不会改变概率。: Subtracting the maximum keeps the exponentials from overflowing; it does not change the probabilities.
整行平移后：LN 与 Softmax 保持，RMS 通常改变: After shifting the whole row: LN and softmax are unchanged, RMS usually changes
比较固定 ε、温度与 Mask，使用仿射之前的归一化结果。退化输入可能让 RMS: Compared with ε, temperature and mask fixed, using the normalized results before the affine step. Degenerate inputs can make RMS happen to stay the same too.
同一个 prompt，比较两个回答的偏好: One prompt, comparing preference between two answers
Bradley–Terry 用奖励差构造偏好概率；这是给定分数的模型，不是人类判: Bradley–Terry builds the preference probability from the reward difference; it is a model of given scores, not the ground truth of human judgement.
横轴只有奖励差 r₀ − r₁ = {#0}，所以两个奖励同时加同一个数，点的位: The horizontal axis is only the reward difference r₀ − r₁ = {#0}, so adding the same number to both rewards does not move the point. The larger the difference, the closer the probability gets to 1, without ever reaching it.
DPO 直接使用偏好对与固定参考策略: DPO uses the preference pair and a fixed reference policy directly
这里把完整回答当作单动作；真实回答的 log 概率是各 token 条件 log: Here a complete answer is treated as a single action; the log-probability of a real answer is the sum of each token's conditional log-probability. On the DPO path no separate reward model is trained.
当前 m = {#0}。被偏好回答相对参考策略的概率比越高，m 越大，损失越小；: Current m = {#0}. The higher the probability ratio of the preferred answer relative to the reference policy, the larger m and the smaller the loss; the loss always stays above 0, with no point where it stops.
PPO-Clip 是目标中的 min，不是强制裁剪策略: PPO-Clip is a min inside the objective, not a forced clipping of the policy
A 的正负会改变哪一侧受限制。这里只算单项 surrogate，省略 criti: The sign of A decides which side is limited. Only a single surrogate term is computed here; critic, GAE, sampling and optimization are left out.
A = {#0} > 0：ρ 超过 1 + ε 后实线变平，再增大 ρ 也得不到: A = {#0} > 0: once ρ exceeds 1 + ε the solid line goes flat, and increasing ρ further gains nothing; the dashed line is the unclipped ρA.
A = {#0} < 0：ρ 低于 1 − ε 后实线变平；ρ 偏大时仍按 ρA: A = {#0} < 0: once ρ falls below 1 − ε the solid line goes flat; when ρ is large it still counts as ρA, and the objective keeps falling.
A = 0：两项都是 0，目标与 ρ 无关。: A = 0: both terms are 0, and the objective does not depend on ρ.
GRPO 的组：同一 prompt 的四个回答: A GRPO group: four answers to the same prompt
采用总体标准差作为教学约定。零方差时优势设为 0，避免除零；不能混用不同 pro: The population standard deviation is a teaching convention. With zero variance the advantages are set to 0 to avoid dividing by zero; answers to different prompts must not be mixed into one group.
四个奖励相同，标准差为 0：本页约定优势全为 0，不做除法。: The four rewards are equal and the standard deviation is 0: by this page's convention all advantages are 0 and no division happens.
两行的刻度对齐了：减去均值 {#0}、除以标准差 {#1}，上面的“均值 ± σ: The two rows have aligned scales: subtract the mean {#0} and divide by the standard deviation {#1}, and “mean ± σ” above lands exactly on ±1 below; each answer's relative position stays the same.
组优势乘概率比，再减参考约束估计项: Group advantage times probability ratio, minus the reference-constraint estimate
参考 KL 样本估计项: sample estimate of the reference KL
用 R1 的 ref/current − log(ref/current) −: Uses R1's sample term ref/current − log(ref/current) − 1; this is not the full distributional KL on a single answer. With zero advantage the reference constraint can still take effect.
奖励平移不改组内相对优势；蒸馏是另一条监督路径: Shifting rewards does not change the relative advantages within a group; distillation is a separate supervision path
教师分布取给定奖励的 Softmax，只用于示意概率匹配。没有闭源模型训练细节或: The teacher distribution is the softmax of the given rewards and only illustrates probability matching. No training details of closed models or hidden reasoning are involved; a larger sampling budget does not guarantee better answers either.
当前 c = 0，前两行重合。拖动“奖励共同平移 c”：点和均值一起平移，优势一: Currently c = 0, so the first two rows coincide. Drag “common reward shift c”: the points and the mean move together, and the advantage row stays put. The two distillation distributions are in the table on the right.
每个奖励都加 c = {#0}，组均值也加 c：差值不变，所以第三行的优势和平移: Every reward gets c = {#0} added, and so does the group mean: the differences stay the same, so the advantages in the third row are the same as before the shift. The two distillation distributions are in the table on the right.
奖励共同平移后优势不变: advantages unchanged by a common reward shift
零方差边界优势为零: advantages are zero at the zero-variance edge
短竖线是能表示的全部格点: the short ticks are every representable grid point
{#0} 组各有自己的格点间距，图中不画格点: the {#0} groups each have their own grid spacing; the grid points are not drawn
{#0}；每个数只能落到其中一个格点上: {#0}; each number can only land on one of the grid points
{#0}；连线从原位置指向最近的格点: {#0}; lines go from the original position to the nearest grid point
{#0}；虚线是校准边界，超出的数被压到边界上: {#0}; dashed lines are the calibration bounds, numbers beyond them are pushed onto the bound
同一把尺：比较一组共用尺度与分组各用尺度，小数值离原位置有多远: One ruler: compare one shared scale with a scale per group, and how far the small values land from their original position
{#0}；连线越斜，这一项的误差越大: {#0}; the more slanted the line, the larger that entry's error
对称整数格点：共享尺度与零点 0: Symmetric integer grid: shared scale and zero point 0
采用 [−qmax, qmax]，有一个补码编码未使用；不是所有量化格式的通用规: Uses [−qmax, qmax], leaving one two's-complement code unused; this is not a general rule for every quantization format.
先裁剪，再按尺度舍入到整数: Clip first, then round to an integer by the scale
本例半整数采用远离零的舍入规则；不同实现的 ties-to-even 可能得到不: Halfway values round away from zero in this example; implementations using ties-to-even can give different results.
校准上限变小，格点更密，也更容易截断异常值: A smaller calibration cap makes the grid denser, but outliers get clipped more easily
cap 限制每组最大绝对值；这是可控的教学校准规则。: cap limits the largest absolute value in each group; this is a controllable teaching calibration rule.
分组让不同区间拥有不同尺度: Grouping gives different ranges different scales
全向量共用尺度的还原: restored with one scale for the whole vector
组更小需要更多尺度元数据；不是无代价提高精度。: Smaller groups need more scale metadata; precision does not improve for free.
一个异常大值，会拉宽所在组的格点: One unusually large value widens the grid of its group
存储账本与误差同时检查: Check the storage ledger and the error together
将当前八个数看作线性层一行权重，用固定激活 u 核对输出误差。账本假设整数紧密打: Treat the current eight numbers as one row of a linear layer's weights and check the output error with a fixed activation u. The ledger assumes tightly packed integers and one 4 B scale per group, without alignment or format headers; JS does not actually bit-pack. GGUF is a format, not a single quantization algorithm.
整数在有效编码范围内: integers within the valid code range
零输入可还原: a zero input can be restored
u = {#0} 落在 {#1} 的区间 [{#2}, {#3})，所以这次选: u = {#0} falls in the interval [{#2}, {#3}) of {#1}, so this time {#4} is picked. Removed candidates have intervals of length 0 and can never be picked.
a、b、c 是玩具词表；没有调用语言模型。: a, b, c are a toy vocabulary; no language model is called.
温度先除 logits，再归一化: The temperature divides the logits first, then they are normalized
τ > 0；较小温度强化较高分数。全部同分时仍均匀。: τ > 0; a lower temperature strengthens higher scores. If all scores are equal, the distribution stays uniform.
三个 logits 相同，三条线重合在 1/3：温度改变不了均匀分布。: The three logits are equal, so the three lines coincide at 1/3: temperature cannot change a uniform distribution.
每条线是一个候选的概率随 τ 的变化，竖线是当前 τ。往左（τ 小），最高分越来: Each line is one candidate's probability as τ changes, and the vertical line is the current τ. To the left (small τ) the top score dominates more and more; to the right (large τ) the three lines move closer together.
Top-K 按概率排序，恰好留下 K 个: Top-k sorts by probability and keeps exactly K
并列时按 token ID；这是恰好 K 个的教学规则，部分库按阈值保留并列项时: Ties go by token ID; this is a teaching rule that keeps exactly K, while some libraries keep tied items by threshold and may exceed K.
从高到低排好，前 K = {#0} 个保留；空心柱是筛选前的概率，实心柱是除以保: Sorted from high to low, the top K = {#0} are kept; hollow bars are the probabilities before filtering, solid bars the probabilities after dividing by the kept sum {#1}.
在 Top-K 分布上做 Top-P，保留跨过阈值的一项: Top-p on the top-k distribution, keeping the item that crosses the threshold
本例明确先 K 后 P；P 的累计是在当时的归一化分布上计算。: This example explicitly applies K before P; the cumulative sum for P is computed on the distribution normalized at that point.
折线是从高到低的累计概率，虚线是 P = {#0}。累计第一次 ≥ P 的是 {: The line is the cumulative probability from high to low, the dashed line is P = {#0}. The first item where the cumulative sum is ≥ P is {#1} (cumulative {#2}); it is kept too, and everything after it is removed.
P = 1：累计要到全部正概率项加完才达到 1，所以一项也不删。: P = 1: the cumulative sum only reaches 1 once every positive-probability item has been added, so nothing is removed.
固定种子生成一次均匀数，落在哪段就选谁: A fixed seed generates one uniform number; whichever segment it lands in is picked
固定种子可复现一次抽样；一次结果不代表长期频率。: A fixed seed makes one draw reproducible; a single result says nothing about long-run frequencies.
两步树：局部最大不保证序列联合概率最大: Two-step tree: a local maximum does not guarantee the largest joint sequence probability
第一步用当前温度分布；条件表固定，不应用 Top-K/P。固定长度 2，无 EO: The first step uses the current temperature distribution; the conditional table is fixed and top-k/p are not applied. Fixed length 2, no EOS and no length penalty; in general, beam search can also prune away the global optimum.
采样 token 位于保留集合: the sampled token is in the kept set
已算到 t{#0}：这一步只用上一步的状态 {#1} 和当前输入；后面的状态还没: Computed up to t{#0}: this step uses only the previous state {#1} and the current input; later states are not computed yet.
把过去折进一个状态，再读出输出: Fold the past into one state, then read out the output
标量 SSM 教学示例；输入四个时间步，不代表真实模型的隐藏维度。: Scalar SSM teaching example; the input has four time steps and does not represent a real model's hidden dimension.
每一步：旧状态 × 保留系数 + 写入量 = 新状态。固定参数时每一步的保留系数: Each step: old state × keep factor + write = new state. With fixed parameters the keep factor is {#0} at every step; to the right of the arrow there is always just one number, never a list of history.
选择性：Δ、B、C 由当前输入决定: Selectivity: Δ, B and C are set by the current input
本例用 softplus(0.5x) 生成步长、线性投影生成 B/C。A 保持固: This example generates the step size with softplus(0.5x) and B/C with linear projections. A stays fixed; Mamba's convolution, gating and expansion projections are left out.
三条线是本页的选择规则：Δ = Δ·softplus(0.5x) 始终为正，B、: The three lines are this page's selection rules: Δ = Δ·softplus(0.5x) is always positive, and B and C change linearly with x. The vertical lines are the four inputs; the intersections are Δ_t, B_t and C_t in the table.
固定参数模式：三条线都是水平线，Δ、B、C 与输入无关，每一步都用同一组参数。: Fixed-parameter mode: all three lines are horizontal; Δ, B and C do not depend on the input, and every step uses the same parameters.
零阶保持离散化：旧状态系数与新输入注入: Zero-order-hold discretization: the coefficient for the old state and the injection of new input
B̄ = expm1(ΔA)/A × B，A=0 时用极限 ΔB。不是把连续 B: B̄ = expm1(ΔA)/A × B, with the limit ΔB when A = 0. The continuous B is not simply used as the discrete B̄.
A = 0：保留系数恒为 1，写入系数等于 Δ。: A = 0: the keep factor is always 1 and the write coefficient equals Δ.

With A = 0 the keep factor is always 1.
A = 0：曲线是 1 的水平线，Δ 不改变保留系数。: A = 0: the curve is the horizontal line at 1, and Δ does not change the keep factor.
A = {#0} < 0：曲线一路下降。小 Δ 的保留系数接近 1，旧状态留得多: A = {#0} < 0: the curve falls all the way. With a small Δ the keep factor is close to 1 and much of the old state stays; with a large Δ it decays faster. Dots are the four Δ_t ({#1}), squares the fixed Δ.
